Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Acasus:




“Impact for citizens.”




Acasus helps governments help people.




We are a consultancy delivering transformational reforms in health and education. We have built a reputation in dynamic, and often challenging, countries and contexts.




Acasus undertakes high-profile projects in an expanding group of countries, including: Pakistan, Chad, the DRC, Mozambique, Somalia, Afghanistan, Ethiopia and Nigeria. From increasing vaccine delivery, to providing greater education access for children, our consultants are helping millions of people access better services.




Apply to join us if you want the opportunity to do the same.




How will you make an impact?




You will use the latest data management technologies to improve health and education services for citizens in a number of low- and middle-income countries, including the DRC, Ethiopia, Afghanistan, Pakistan, Mozambique, Somalia, Chad, and others.




Tasks and responsibilities:

Work closely with local Associates to create regular analysis and data visualisations for all project stakeholders, including government officials
Understand general and country-specific project requirements
Deliver dashboards and data processing flows
Develop data processing flows that can be used as standards for multiple projects
Work on multiple projects simultaneously
Educate and support other associates and Data Analysts
Collaborate with other functional areas, such as Operations and Engineering




We are looking for:

2+ years of experience in data analysis
Advanced Tableau data visualisation skills, including dashboard design practices
Advanced analytical skills
Ability to present insights to senior stakeholders and decision makers
Advanced SQL skills
Experience with building and maintaining ETL flows is a plus
Experience with unstructured data (e.g. JSON files) is beneficial
Experience with geographic information system (GIS) analysis
Experience with Python or other programming languages is advantageous
Able to work individually and as part of a team
Excellent communication skills
Proficiency in written and spoken English




What's in it for you?

A competitive compensation package
Private Health Insurance
Cafeteria
Year-end bonus based on company and individual performance
High degrees of responsibility and autonomy
Opportunity to learn and grow in an enthusiastic and supportive environment
See your work have a tangible impact on health and education services every day




Our team is diverse in nationality, gender, race, religion, ethnicity, class, age, education and sexuality. Consequently, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

Title: Data Analyst Senior F/H
Description:
Rattaché(e) à la direction Digital & Data d’Ulys, le/la Data Analyst Senior a pour mission de développer une connaissance approfondie des clients et prospects afin de produire des analyses directement actionnables.

Il/elle contribue activement à la création de valeur à partir de la donnée pour :


accélérer le développement du parc clients,
améliorer la performance commerciale,
éclairer les décisions sur les stratégies produit, relationnelle et marketing.



Avec une forte orientation business et client, le/la Data Analyst Senior joue un rôle clé dans la définition et la mise en œuvre des stratégies d’Ulys.

Appétence pour les outils d’IA (notamment IA générative) appliqués à l’analyse de données afin d’accélérer la production d’insights

Missions principales :

Au sein d’une équipe de 5 personnes, vous serez en charge de :

1. Analyse & business impact

Comprendre les enjeux des équipes métiers et traduire leurs besoins en analyses data

Produire des analyses à forte valeur ajoutée : segmentation clients, comportements, saisonnalité, performance campagnes

Identifier des leviers de fidélisation et de création de valeur

2. Performance commerciale

Accompagner l’optimisation des actions d’acquisition et de développement du parc

Mesurer l’efficacité des dispositifs commerciaux et recommander des axes d’amélioration

3. Contribution à la stratégie produit

Analyser les usages des solutions Ulys

Alimenter les décisions produit avec des insights data

4. Pilotage & datavisualisation

Concevoir et maintenir des dashboards de pilotage (Power BI)

Structurer des indicateurs de performance fiables et partagés

5. Vision client 360°

Contribuer à l’enrichissement de la connaissance client (nouvelles données, nouveaux indicateurs)

Participer à la formalisation des besoins data avec les équipes produit (spécifications, recette)


Structuration & partage



Documenter les analyses et méthodes

Contribuer à la montée en compétence des équipes.

Profil recherché :


Bac +5 en statistiques, économétrie ou data
Expérience ≥ 5 ans en data analyse dans un environnement marketing / client
Expérience en business par abonnement ou B2B appréciée



Compétences clés

Techniques


Maîtrise avancée de SQL
Bonne pratique de Python ou R
Expérience en outils BI (Power BI, Tableau…)



Data & analyse


Capacité à structurer et challenger les analyses
Rigueur et fiabilité dans la production de résultats



Business & communication


Capacité à traduire la data en recommandations actionnables
Aisance à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs non techniques



Soft skills


Esprit analytique et orienté résultats
Autonomie, proactivité
Bon relationnel et capacité à travailler en transverse
Orientation client forte
Vous occuperez un rôle stratégique au cœur des enjeux data et expérience client
Vous évoluerez au sein d'une équipe engagée et dynamique, dans un environnement favorisant l’autonomie et l’impact
Nous vous offrons des conditions de travail attractives (télétravail, localisation, avantages...).

Title: Junior Data & BI Analyst
Description:
En Solcasino buscamos incorporar un/a Junior Data & BI Analyst con una sólida formación cuantitativa y una clara especialización en datos, analítica y Business Intelligence.




Esta posición está especialmente pensada para recién graduados o profesionales en sus primeras experiencias laborales que quieran desarrollarse rápidamente trabajando con datos reales de negocio y participando en la toma de decisiones de diferentes áreas de la compañía.

No buscamos una larga experiencia profesional. Buscamos muy buena base técnica, capacidad analítica, curiosidad y alto potencial de desarrollo.




¿Qué harás?

Analizar grandes volúmenes de datos relacionados con clientes, producto, marketing y operaciones.
Preparar, limpiar y transformar datos para diferentes análisis de negocio.
Construir consultas SQL y realizar análisis utilizando Python.
Crear dashboards, reporting y herramientas de Business Intelligence.
Analizar comportamiento de clientes, segmentaciones, cohortes y tendencias.
Apoyar análisis relacionados con adquisición, CRM, promociones, producto y operaciones.
Detectar anomalías, patrones y oportunidades a partir de los datos.
Ayudar a diferentes departamentos a responder preguntas concretas de negocio.
Transformar información compleja en conclusiones claras y accionables.
Evolucionar progresivamente hacia análisis estadísticos, predictivos y proyectos de mayor complejidad.




Formación académica

Buscamos candidatos con una formación cuantitativa sólida, preferiblemente en:

Matemáticas
Estadística
Matemática Aplicada
Ingeniería
Física
Econometría
Data Science
Informática con fuerte componente cuantitativo
O titulaciones similares

Además, valoraremos especialmente una especialización adicional en áreas como:

Business Intelligence
Data Analytics
Data Science
Estadística aplicada
Big Data
Analytics Engineering

Será especialmente valorable contar con un Máster en Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Data Science o similar.

Nos interesan especialmente perfiles que combinen una fuerte base matemática o estadística con una formación práctica en BI y análisis de datos.




Conocimientos técnicos

Buscamos una buena base, académica o práctica, en:

SQL
Python aplicado al análisis de datos
Excel avanzado
Herramientas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Tableau, Looker o similares
Estadística aplicada
Preparación, limpieza y transformación de datos
Visualización de datos
Modelado de datos

No es necesario tener experiencia profesional previa con todas estas herramientas, pero sí una buena base técnica y muchas ganas de desarrollarse.

Inglés

Es imprescindible un muy buen nivel de inglés hablado y escrito.

La persona debe sentirse cómoda:

Participando en reuniones profesionales en inglés.
Trabajando con equipos y proveedores internacionales.
Leyendo documentación técnica en inglés.
Explicando análisis, conclusiones y recomendaciones en inglés.




¿Qué buscamos?

Buscamos una persona:

Muy analítica y cómoda trabajando con números.
Con fuerte capacidad matemática y lógica.
Curiosa y con interés por entender por qué suceden las cosas.
Rigurosa y atenta al detalle.
Capaz de trabajar con información compleja.
Capaz de transformar datos en conclusiones sencillas y útiles.
Interesada en comprender el negocio, no únicamente en generar reporting.
Con muchas ganas de aprender y desarrollarse rápidamente.
Proactiva y con capacidad para cuestionar los datos cuando algo no encaja.

Valoraremos especialmente

Proyectos académicos o personales relacionados con datos.
Experiencia con Pandas y NumPy.
Buen nivel de Power BI.
Conocimientos de modelado de datos.
Conocimientos básicos de Machine Learning.
Experiencia académica trabajando con grandes datasets.
Conocimientos de bases de datos.
Conocimientos de APIs o pipelines de datos.
Uso de herramientas de IA aplicadas al análisis.
Haber desarrollado dashboards o modelos analíticos en proyectos académicos o personales.

No es necesario haber trabajado anteriormente en el sector gaming.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

La oportunidad de comenzar y desarrollar tu carrera trabajando con datos reales dentro de una compañía digital en crecimiento.

No queremos que esta posición se limite a preparar informes.

Buscamos desarrollar progresivamente una persona que pueda convertirse en una referencia analítica dentro de la compañía, combinando datos, estadística, Business Intelligence y conocimiento del negocio para ayudarnos a tomar mejores decisiones.

Desde el inicio tendrás exposición a problemas reales de negocio relacionados con clientes, marketing, producto y operaciones.

Title: Data Analyst H/F
Description:
Le poste :

En tant que Data Analyst rattaché(e) au Pôle Pilotage commercial de la Direction de la Distribution, vous contribuez à la fiabilisation, la sécurisation et le traitement des données en assurant la consolidation des objectifs commerciaux.

Vous participez également à la production d'analyses et à la valorisation des données au travers d'outils de reporting et de visualisation destinés à accompagner le pilotage de l'activité.

Vos missions principales :

Vous participez à la consolidation et à la mise à disposition des objectifs commerciaux afin de garantir un pilotage fiable de l’activité :


Vous consolidez les données relatives aux objectifs commerciaux et assurez leur déclinaison à l’ensemble des niveaux de l’organisation (territoires, directions, entités, équipes, collaborateurs).
Vous contrôlez la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées dans le cadre des campagnes annuelles de fixation des objectifs.
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers afin de recueillir, challenger et intégrer les évolutions nécessaires au pilotage commercial.
Vous transformez et valorisez les données issues de différentes sources (notamment Excel) afin d’alimenter les outils de reporting et les tableaux de bord Power BI.
Vous analysez les indicateurs commerciaux pour contribuer à la prise de décision et à l’amélioration de la performance.


Selon les besoins de l’équipe et les demandes entrantes, vous intervenez ponctuellement sur les requêtages et traitements de données nécessaires à la production des indicateurs (maintenance corrective, évolution et création de tableaux de bord, accompagnement des utilisateurs et traitement des anomalies).

Profil de candidat recherché :

Expérience souhaitée :


Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en Statistiques, Informatique Décisionnelle, Data ou en Contrôle de Gestion.
Votre expérience en consolidation annuelle des données dans un environnement orienté Contrôle de Gestion serait un plus à votre candidature.


Qualités personnelles :


Vous appréciez travailler avec des équipes métiers pluridisciplinaires.


Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.Vous êtes autonome dans la conduite de vos missions et force de proposition.

Outils informatiques :


Vous maitrisez impérativement les modèles décisionnels, le langage SQL et un outil de data visualisation (idéalement Power BI).
Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils digitaux et bureautiques.
Vous serez formé(e) aux logiciels et aux processus internes d’Harmonie Mutuelle.


Nos avantages :


Accord d’intéressement
Télétravail jusqu'à 3 jours par semaine (à partir de 6 mois d'ancienneté)
22,5 jours de RTT par an
Carte déjeuner à 9,50 € (60 % pris en charge par l’employeur) et avantages CSE (enveloppes loisirs, culture, avantages vacances…)
Forfait mobilité durable : jusqu’à 400 € par an (cumulable avec le remboursement de l’abonnement aux transports en commun, dans la limite de 600 euros au total)
Contrat collectif santé et prévoyance
Plan d’épargne entreprise, plan d’épargne retraite et compte épargne temps
Formation : un parcours complet avec une plateforme d’apprentissage en ligne
2 jours d'engagement solidaire par an au profit d’associations


Le processus de recrutement :


Evaluation de votre CV par le recruteur
Entretien téléphonique avec le recruteur
Entretien avec le recruteur et avec votre futur manager
Test de personnalité suivi d’un débrief avec le recruteur


Compétences :

sens du relationnel

Vous participez également à la production d'analyses et à la valorisation des données au travers d'outils de reporting et de visualisation destinés à accompagner le pilotage de l'activité.

Vos missions principales :

Vous participez à la consolidation et à la mise à disposition des objectifs commerciaux afin de garantir un pilotage fiable de l’activité :

  • Vous consolidez les données relatives aux objectifs commerciaux et assurez leur déclinaison à l’ensemble des niveaux de l’organisation (territoires, directions, entités, équipes, collaborateurs).
  • Vous contrôlez la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées dans le cadre des campagnes annuelles de fixation des objectifs.
  • Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers afin de recueillir, challenger et intégrer les évolutions nécessaires au pilotage commercial.
  • Vous transformez et valorisez les données issues de différentes sources (notamment Excel) afin d’alimenter les outils de reporting et les tableaux de bord Power BI.
  • Vous analysez les indicateurs commerciaux pour contribuer à la prise de décision et à l’amélioration de la performance.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe et les demandes entrantes, vous intervenez ponctuellement sur les requêtages et traitements de données nécessaires à la production des indicateurs (maintenance corrective, évolution et création de tableaux de bord, accompagnement des utilisateurs et traitement des anomalies).

Profil de candidat recherché :

Expérience souhaitée :

  • Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en Statistiques, Informatique Décisionnelle, Data ou en Contrôle de Gestion.
  • Votre expérience en consolidation annuelle des données dans un environnement orienté Contrôle de Gestion serait un plus à votre candidature.

Qualités personnelles :

  • Vous appréciez travailler avec des équipes métiers pluridisciplinaires.

Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.Vous êtes autonome dans la conduite de vos missions et force de proposition.

Outils informatiques :

  • Vous maitrisez impérativement les modèles décisionnels, le langage SQL et un outil de data visualisation (idéalement Power BI).
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils digitaux et bureautiques.
  • Vous serez formé(e) aux logiciels et aux processus internes d’Harmonie Mutuelle.

Nos avantages :

  • Accord d’intéressement
  • Télétravail jusqu'à 3 jours par semaine (à partir de 6 mois d'ancienneté)
  • 22,5 jours de RTT par an
  • Carte déjeuner à 9,50 € (60 % pris en charge par l’employeur) et avantages CSE (enveloppes loisirs, culture, avantages vacances…)
  • Forfait mobilité durable : jusqu’à 400 € par an (cumulable avec le remboursement de l’abonnement aux transports en commun, dans la limite de 600 euros au total)
  • Contrat collectif santé et prévoyance
  • Plan d’épargne entreprise, plan d’épargne retraite et compte épargne temps
  • Formation : un parcours complet avec une plateforme d’apprentissage en ligne
  • 2 jours d'engagement solidaire par an au profit d’associations

Le processus de recrutement :

  • Evaluation de votre CV par le recruteur
  • Entretien téléphonique avec le recruteur
  • Entretien avec le recruteur et avec votre futur manager
  • Test de personnalité suivi d’un débrief avec le recruteur

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Department

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze and curate data sources to support business and product stakeholders in making informed decisions.
Lead key components of the analytical lifecycle, including data exploration, analysis, reporting, and insight delivery.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.
Define and document datasets, business logic, and reporting definitions to support consistent data usage.
Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.
Analyze user engagement, operational, and product data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, and stakeholder collaboration.
Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools that support reporting, documentation, and analysis workflows preferred.
High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders


What We Offer 


You will have the opportunity to accelerate in our rapidly growing organization.
Agile working environment with flexible working hours and location, career advancement, and competitive compensation package.
We are a family friendly company.
We arrange social activities to help our employees and families become familiar with each other and our culture.
In addition to other benefits, we offer a pension scheme and 100% complimentary and confidential mental health services.

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
As an F&B Data Analyst, you are at the center of complex challenges within the food and beverage industry. You translate large volumes of raw data, such as sales figures, inventory movements, consumer trends and production data, into clear strategic insights and concrete action points for our clients and internal teams.

Our company is based out of Vianen, Utrecht (NL). We are unable to offer work sponsorship for this role.

Who we are:

At Real Result, we are the independent purchasing experts for the dynamic foodservice industry. We help our clients maximize their procurement, whether it's through volume discounts, purchasing optimization, real-time cost price insights, or the realization of commercial kitchens and bars. We are looking for talent that helps our clients achieve their ambitions. Since 2025, Real Result has been part of Buyers Edge Platform, a digital procurement network/software platform for the foodservice industry that connects operators, distributors, and manufacturers. The platform offers group purchasing services, SaaS-based technology solutions, and supply chain consulting and procurement-related services to foodservice parties with the aim of reducing costs and improving supply chain decisions through data-driven technology. As a Buyer at Real Result, you are the linchpin in strategic purchasing processes. You work closely with various leading players in the sector, from hospitality to catering and from Leisure to on-the-move. Our client base is diverse and impressive. Think of names like Ron Blaauw, Perfect Serve, Albron, Beerze Bulten, Vue Cinemas, Koninklijk Theater Carré, and many others.

Your impact:


Data Analysis & Reporting: Develop, maintain and automate dashboards, KPI reports and analyses tailored to the food and beverage market.
Trend & Market Analysis: Identify consumption trends, seasonal effects and cost fluctuations within the F&B sector.
Advisory: Proactively advise clients and management based on data-driven insights to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
Data Quality Management: Safeguard the quality, integrity and reliability of supplied and processed data sources.
Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders to implement client-specific data solutions.
Accuracy and timeliness of delivered dashboards and analyses.
Measurable cost savings or efficiency gains realized for clients based on your recommendations.
Successful adoption and use of data tools by end users.


About you:


Education: Vocational (MBO) or bachelor's (HBO) degree in (Business) Mathematics, Data Science, Econometrics, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
Experience: 2 to 5 years of relevant work experience as a data analyst or in a similar role, preferably within the Food & Beverage, FMCG or retail sector.
Technical skills:
Excellent command of SQL and Excel.
Experience with visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Competencies: Strong analytical skills, results-oriented, communicative (able to translate complex data into understandable language for non-technical stakeholders) and commercially aware.


What We Offer:


A market-based salary aligned with your knowledge and experience, plus an attractive benefits package, including 25 vacation days, holiday allowance and flexible working hours.
Laptop and mobile phone.
Company car or mobility allowance
Excellent benefits and development opportunities.
Room for initiative and personal growth within an innovative and ambitious organization.
An inspiring work environment with passionate colleagues from the industry.


We welcome all.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

Title: Senior BI Data Analyst
Description:
I’m Donatas Šeputis, and I’m looking for a curious, experienced data professional to join us in shaping the future of data and analytics at City Service SE group.

We're building a new, modern data platform — scalable, seamlessly integrated across systems, and designed to turn data into a self-service, 'speak to your data' experience.

We're looking for a Senior BI Data Analyst to turn well-governed data into clear insight and decision-ready reporting across the business. You'll work across a modern data stack — including Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake, Power BI, Apache Airflow, and GIT — with AI-assisted development support via Claude, partnering closely with our data engineering team to shape what gets modeled, reported, and delivered to the business.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain BI dashboards, reports, and self-service analytics solutions on top of our MS SQL and Snowflake environments.
Translate business questions into data models, metrics, and visualizations that are accurate, intuitive, and reusable.
Partner with data engineers to define requirements for the semantic/analytics layer, ensuring datasets are structured for reliable reporting.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries for analysis, validation, and ad hoc business questions.
Define and maintain key business metrics, KPI definitions, and a single source of truth across reporting tools (Power BI).
Ensure data quality, consistency, and traceability in reports through validation checks and reconciliation with source systems.
Maintain version-controlled reporting logic and documentation using Git, following review best practices.
Collaborate with business and IT teams, gathering requirements and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support data security, access management, and GDPR-aligned governance practices in reporting and dashboards.
Prepare optimized, reliable datasets and visualizations for analytics, reporting, and AI-driven analytical solutions.
Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, and dashboard development.
Participate in technical design reviews and propose improvements to reporting architecture and data visualization standards.
Mentor and support the technical growth of junior/mid-level analysts.


What We Expect from You:


A university degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
4+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, or analytics engineering.
Strong SQL skills, with hands-on experience in (complex queries, performance-aware query writing).
Experience with cloud data warehousing, ideally Snowflake.
Hands-on experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable BI tool.
Familiarity with ETL/ELT pipelines and orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, and how they feed downstream reporting.
Proficiency with Git for version control and collaborative development.
Working knowledge of Python or another scripting language for data analysis and automation is a plus.
Understanding of data warehouse and analytics architecture, including layered ("medallion"-style) data processing approaches.
Experience ensuring data quality, accuracy, and reliability across test and production reporting environments.
Comfort working with AI-assisted tools (e.g. Claude) as part of the analytics workflow.
Ability to collaborate across teams, communicating insights clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

At Devoteam, we believe that technology with strong human values can actively drive change for the better. Discover how Tech for People unlocks the future, creating a positive impact on the people and the world around us. We are a global leading player in Digital Transformation for leading organisations across EMEA, with a revenue of €1B. We believe in transforming technology to create value for our clients, partners and employees in a world where technology is developed for people. We are proud of the culture we have built together. We are proud of our people at the service of technology. We are proud of our diverse environment. Because we are #TechforPeople. Join our multidisciplinary team of Cloud experts, Designers, Business consultants, Security experts, Engineers, Developers and other extraordinary talents, spread across more than 20 EMEA countries. Become one of our +10.000 tech and business leaders on cloud, data and cyber security. Let’s fuse creativity with technology together and build innovative solutions that actively change things for the better.

Job Description

We are looking for a sharp and insightful Data Analyst to join our Business Intelligence (BI) team. You will be the crucial link between raw data and strategic decisions, responsible for gathering business requirements, transforming complex data, and creating compelling visualizations that drive action across the organization.

Key Responsibilities


Gather and translate business needs into technical requirements for data models and reporting solutions.
Develop, optimize, and execute SQL queries to extract, transform, and load data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Design and build dynamic dashboards and reports, primarily using Power BI, to monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable business insights.
Perform root-cause analysis on data discrepancies and collaborate with Data Engineers to ensure data quality and availability.
Present findings and strategic recommendations to stakeholders, clearly communicating complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Participate in the full lifecycle of BI projects, from requirements gathering to final deployment.



Qualifications


3+ years of proven experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in a similar role focused on data and reporting.
Strong mandatory proficiency in SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets.
Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, data manipulation, automation, and scripting (e.g., using Pandas, NumPy, or similar libraries).
Expert hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI (or similar BI tools) for data modeling, visualization, and publishing reports.
Proven ability to gather, document, and manage business requirements effectively.
Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills with data.
Experience with Microsoft Excel for data analysis and modeling is expected.



Valued Skills:


Experience with other components of the Microsoft Data Stack (e.g., Azure Synapse, Azure Analysis Services).
Knowledge of Data Modeling principles (e.g., Dimensional Modeling).
Professional fluency (B2+) in French is highly valued and may be a mandatory requirement for allocation on specific projects with Francophone clients.



Additional Information

If that sounds like you, you'll feel at home here. We're looking for people who see challenges as puzzles, not problems, thrive in fast-growing, high-energy environments, and want to shape the future of mobility, not just watch it unfold. At Powerdot, you'll get freedom, ownership, and responsibility. The space to experiment. The chance to scale your ideas. And a team that's always pushing the edge of what's possible.

🚀 About This Role

As our Data Analyst, you'll be part of the Central Data team at Powerdot and will play a key role in the current phase of accelerated growth. Your mission is to transform raw data into clear, actionable insights that power smarter decisions across the business — ensuring every team has the visibility they need to move fast and move well. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

How You'll Shape Our Story:

Your day-to-day will include

Gathering and transforming data from a variety of sources — including internal databases, external APIs, and surveys, ensuring data is ready for analysis.
Analyzing data using statistical techniques — identifying trends, patterns, and insights that drive smarter business decisions.
Developing data visualizations — creating clear, compelling dashboards and reports that communicate findings to stakeholders in a concise and actionable way.
Partnering with stakeholders — understanding their needs and developing data-driven solutions that address real business questions.
Championing data quality — maintaining and supporting a culture of strong data quality across teams and workflows.
Staying ahead of analytics trends — keeping up-to-date on the latest tools, techniques, and best practices in data analytics.
Mentoring colleagues — coaching co-workers on analytics best practices and helping elevate the team's overall data capability.

This Is About You, Not Us 🫵🏼:

Up to 4 years of experience in data analytics or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — you know how to break down complex questions and find the signal in the noise.
Technical proficiency — familiar with SQL, Python, and at least one data visualization tool such as Tableau, Metabase, or Power BI.
Eagerness to learn and develop — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and proactively grow your skills.
Great communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and complexity — you navigate unstructured problems with ease and bring clarity to chaos.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team — you're self-driven but collaborative when it counts.

The Kind of Energy We're Looking For:

We're not into titles, egos, or corporate buzzwords. We're into people who make things happen.

You lead and listen. Whether you're steering the ship or rowing alongside the crew, you bring others with you and keep communication wide open.
You own your stuff. You don't wait for instructions: you see an opportunity, grab it, and make it better than anyone expected.
You've got a green heartbeat. Sustainability isn't just cool, it's core. You care about doing work that leaves the world a little better than you found it.
You balance hustle with humanity. You love the buzz of in-person teamwork, but you also know when to recharge (pun totally intended 🔋).
You grow on purpose. You're hungry to learn, to stretch, and to build something meaningful, not just rack up LinkedIn bullet points.

How you'll be Powered up?

🏥 Private health insurance coverage
💪🏼 Gym membership to help you stay active
⏰ Flexible working hours: you own your time
🌍 Annual offsite where we celebrate the year's achievements and spend quality time together (this year we went to Algarve, Portugal!)
🤝🏼 Regular team-building events with your local teammates
📚 English Training — as English is our language used to connect with all markets and teams
🍩 Free office snacks and unlimited coffee & Meal allowance for every worked day
⚡️ Special discounts for charging your electric vehicle

Our Promise To You

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies — they're lived every day. At Powerdot, everyone has the space to speak up, challenge the status quo, and make a difference. Your voice powers the future — literally.

Title: Data-analist
HTML:
Data Analyst AI


Ben jij een analytische Data Analyst die graag data vertaalt naar inzichten die daadwerkelijk gebruikt worden? Wil jij werken op het snijvlak van data, business en technologie binnen een internationale organisatie?


Voor een internationale organisatie in Den Bosch zijn wij op zoek naar een Data Analyst.


Over de functie

Als Data Analyst werk je van businessvraag tot bruikbaar inzicht. Je verzamelt, analyseert, transformeert en modelleert data uit verschillende bronnen en vertaalt deze naar dashboards, rapportages en concrete aanbevelingen.


Je werkt nauw samen met business stakeholders en data-specialisten. Hierdoor ben je niet alleen technisch bezig met data, maar denk je ook actief mee over hoe data de organisatie kan helpen betere beslissingen te nemen.


Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Vertalen van businessvragen naar data-analyses;
  • Verzamelen, transformeren en modelleren van data;
  • Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages;
  • Werken met SQL en BI-tools;
  • Analyseren van datasets en vertalen van uitkomsten naar inzichten;
  • Samenwerken met verschillende business stakeholders;
  • Bewaken van datakwaliteit;
  • Bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van data en analytics;
  • Ondersteunen van teams bij datagedreven besluitvorming.


Jouw kwaliteiten

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau;
  • Circa 2-4 jaar ervaring binnen data-analyse of BI;
  • Goede kennis van SQL;
  • Ervaring met Power BI;
  • Ervaring met Snowflake en/of dbt is een pré;
  • Python-kennis is mooi meegenomen;
  • Analytisch sterk en communicatief vaardig;
  • Je kunt technische inzichten goed vertalen naar de business;
  • Nieuwsgierig en leergierig.


Over de organisatie

Je komt terecht bij een internationale organisatie binnen de educatieve sector. Vanuit verschillende Europese landen wordt gewerkt aan digitale en fysieke oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt binnen het onderwijs.

Binnen het data- en analyticsdomein wordt volop gewerkt aan het verder datagedreven maken van de organisatie. Je werkt samen met verschillende data-specialisten en stakeholders en krijgt de ruimte om mee te bouwen aan deze ontwikkeling.


Wat bieden ze je

  • Een uitdagende Data Analyst-rol binnen een organisatie met een organisatie met maatschappelijk belang;
  • Een salaris tot circa €70.000 per jaar op basis van 36 uur;
  • Hybride werken is mogelijk, met flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken;
  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ontwikkeling;
  • Een functie waarin je direct impact maakt met data.


Interesse?

Ben jij klaar voor een volgende stap als Data Analyst en wil jij werken op het snijvlak van data en business? Neem dan contact met ons op en stuur je CV mee.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Department

WDTech - R&D

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

WDTech is W&D’s in-house technology team – a group of collaborative and highly skilled technology professionals, all of whom are leading experts in real estate data, data science, and technology.

WDTech Engineering builds solutions that impact not only our products but also the people and processes across our organization. A commitment to innovation and a passion for disrupting the old-fashioned real estate industry are our highest priorities.

The Impact You Will Have

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will play a key role in delivering trusted data insights and analytics that support business and product decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for analyzing complex datasets, developing reporting solutions and dashboards, and translating data into actionable insights that improve operational effectiveness and support strategic initiatives.

Working closely with Data Analysts, BI Analysts, Data Engineers, Data QA Engineers, Data Scientists, and Product Managers, you will help ensure data products are accurate, scalable, and aligned with evolving business needs as Walker & Dunlop continues to grow as a data-driven organization.

Primary Responsibilities


Analyze and curate data sources to support business and product stakeholders in making informed decisions.
Lead key components of the analytical lifecycle, including data exploration, analysis, reporting, and insight delivery.
Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
Perform data wrangling, transformation, and analysis using SQL and enterprise analytical databases.
Define and document datasets, business logic, and reporting definitions to support consistent data usage.
Partner with data and product teams to support data governance, data quality, and data management processes.
Analyze user engagement, operational, and product data to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics, visualization, and stakeholder collaboration.
Perform other duties as assigned


Education And Experience


Bachelor’s degree preferred, preferably in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
6+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end analytical projects.
Strong experience working with enterprise analytical databases such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar technologies.
Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
Experience with SQL, data transformation, and analytical reporting workflows.
Experience with Python and geospatial analysis preferred.
Real estate, financial services, or related industry experience preferred.


Knowledge, Skills And Abilities


Deep expertise in SQL and data analysis techniques.
Strong proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Understanding of data modeling, ETL processes, and analytical best practices.
Ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings clearly to business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work collaboratively across technical and business teams in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools that support reporting, documentation, and analysis workflows preferred.
High level of accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement.
Ability to show ownership of your work, take on challenges and acknowledge growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes
Courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness in teaming with colleagues and other stakeholders


What We Offer 


You will have the opportunity to accelerate in our rapidly growing organization.
Agile working environment with flexible working hours and location, career advancement, and competitive compensation package.
We are a family friendly company.
We arrange social activities to help our employees and families become familiar with each other and our culture.
In addition to other benefits, we offer a pension scheme and 100% complimentary and confidential mental health services.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. We do not tolerate discrimination, including harassment, based on any characteristic protected by applicable law, such as race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, and genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We strive to be a safe place to ask questions, build professional relationships, and develop careers.

SPAM

Please be wary of recruitment scams. An indication of a scam might be a request for sensitive or bank information at the time of application or emails coming from a non walkerdunlop.com email address. Please call us at 301.215.5500, if you have any concerns about information requested during or after the application process.

Title: Experienced Data Analyst (Ad-network)
Description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

Voodoo Ad-Network is an autonomous product of around 30 people that carries the ambitious mission of providing ad network services. One goal is to leverage Voodoo’s first-party data to improve Voodoo’s monetisation. Moreover, the product is growing through new ventures like opening up to external inventory, reaching the external-advertisers market and social-network monetisation through BeReal’s recent acquisition. Thanks to promising results, our ambition is now to scale up the team to support growth.

The Ad Experience team owns the end-to-end quality of the ads delivered by our network, from ad rendering to data collection. It has a strong focus on viewability, tracker integrity and the diagnostic signals that feed our Machine Learning models. It’s composed of mostly senior Software Engineers, Mobile Developers, QA Engineers and Full Stack Engineers who iterate together to detect issues quickly, improve the user-side ad experience and protect the quality of the data flowing back into the product.

Role

We’re looking for an Experienced Data Analyst to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you will:


Work on end-to-end data projects with the Ad Experience squad to improve ad delivery quality, reduce ad-load and rendering failures, and maintain a high data quality.
Monitor SDK diagnostic events and build alerting, anomaly detection and root-cause analyses on top of the Ad Experience datasets.
Build data collection and transformation pipelines, and actionable dashboards.
Analyze large, complex data sets with billions of events representing the behaviour of mobile game players and of our ad network to investigate ad-quality regressions, attribution discrepancies and SDK rollouts.
Design solutions from scratch, iterate quickly, create POCs, and deploy to production rapidly.
Occasionally leverage Python skills and Statistics skills to support A/B tests on ad-experience changes


Profile


You possess substantial experience in analytical roles, ideally within a web or mobile company or the tech or ad tech industry.
You are highly skilled in SQL and have a proven track record of building production-ready pipelines that handle large and complex data sets.
You have solid experience in ETL development.
You have solid experience with DBT.
You have practical experience with Tableau or another standard dashboard platform, and can create dashboards that are shared company-wide, facilitating data-driven decision-making across departments.
Advanced knowledge of statistical tools and models will be considered a significant advantage.
Development skills, particularly in Python, will be considered a significant advantage
You enjoy working in a fast-paced environment and are able to balance the tradeoff between time-consuming development and rapid results.
You have a solid problem solving mindset as well as a great track record demonstrating ownership and ability to come up with innovative ideas.
A BA/B.Sc degree in Statistics, Math, Engineering, Economy, or other quantitative fields is mandatory for this role.


Our Stack


DBT; Tableau; SQL; Athena; Spark; Python


Benefits


Competitive salary based on experience
Swile Lunch voucher
Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)
Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family
Wellness activities in our Paris office
Remote Fridays

Title: Data Analyst H/F
Description:
Le poste :

En tant que Data Analyst rattaché(e) au Pôle Pilotage commercial de la Direction de la Distribution, vous contribuez à la fiabilisation, la sécurisation et le traitement des données en assurant la consolidation des objectifs commerciaux.

Vous participez également à la production d'analyses et à la valorisation des données au travers d'outils de reporting et de visualisation destinés à accompagner le pilotage de l'activité.

Vos missions principales :

Vous participez à la consolidation et à la mise à disposition des objectifs commerciaux afin de garantir un pilotage fiable de l’activité :


Vous consolidez les données relatives aux objectifs commerciaux et assurez leur déclinaison à l’ensemble des niveaux de l’organisation (territoires, directions, entités, équipes, collaborateurs).
Vous contrôlez la cohérence et la fiabilité des données utilisées dans le cadre des campagnes annuelles de fixation des objectifs.
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers afin de recueillir, challenger et intégrer les évolutions nécessaires au pilotage commercial.
Vous transformez et valorisez les données issues de différentes sources (notamment Excel) afin d’alimenter les outils de reporting et les tableaux de bord Power BI.
Vous analysez les indicateurs commerciaux pour contribuer à la prise de décision et à l’amélioration de la performance.


Selon les besoins de l’équipe et les demandes entrantes, vous intervenez ponctuellement sur les requêtages et traitements de données nécessaires à la production des indicateurs (maintenance corrective, évolution et création de tableaux de bord, accompagnement des utilisateurs et traitement des anomalies).

Profil de candidat recherché :

Expérience souhaitée :


Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+3 à Bac+5 en Statistiques, Informatique Décisionnelle, Data ou en Contrôle de Gestion.
Votre expérience en consolidation annuelle des données dans un environnement orienté Contrôle de Gestion serait un plus à votre candidature.


Qualités personnelles :


Vous appréciez travailler avec des équipes métiers pluridisciplinaires.


Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous êtes reconnu(e) pour vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse.Vous êtes autonome dans la conduite de vos missions et force de proposition.

Outils informatiques :


Vous maitrisez impérativement les modèles décisionnels, le langage SQL et un outil de data visualisation (idéalement Power BI).
Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils digitaux et bureautiques.
Vous serez formé(e) aux logiciels et aux processus internes d’Harmonie Mutuelle.


Nos avantages :


Accord d’intéressement
Télétravail jusqu'à 3 jours par semaine (à partir de 6 mois d'ancienneté)
22,5 jours de RTT par an
Carte déjeuner à 9,50 € (60 % pris en charge par l’employeur) et avantages CSE (enveloppes loisirs, culture, avantages vacances…)
Forfait mobilité durable : jusqu’à 400 € par an (cumulable avec le remboursement de l’abonnement aux transports en commun, dans la limite de 600 euros au total)
Contrat collectif santé et prévoyance
Plan d’épargne entreprise, plan d’épargne retraite et compte épargne temps
Formation : un parcours complet avec une plateforme d’apprentissage en ligne
2 jours d'engagement solidaire par an au profit d’associations


Le processus de recrutement :


Evaluation de votre CV par le recruteur
Entretien téléphonique avec le recruteur
Entretien avec le recruteur et avec votre futur manager
Test de personnalité suivi d’un débrief avec le recruteur

Title: Data Analyst maîtrisant
Description:
Descriptif du poste

Notre entreprise accompagne plusieurs clients dans la structuration, l’analyse et la valorisation de leurs données. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un(e) Data Analyst pour intervenir auprès de différentes organisations sur des enjeux de reporting, data visualisation et modélisation BI.

Vous rejoindrez une équipe data avec pour objectif de collecter, explorer et interpréter les données, puis de mettre à disposition des reportings clairs et utiles pour les équipes produits et métiers.

Vos missions


Accompagner les équipes produits dans l’analyse de leurs données
Concevoir des dashboards et reports lisibles pour le suivi des KPI
Produire des analyses ponctuelles sous forme de présentations ou notes de synthèse
Participer à la modélisation BI et à la conception des flux de données
Définir des bonnes pratiques et guidelines pour fiabiliser la production des indicateurs et tableaux de bord


Profil recherché


Formation : Bac+4/5 en data, statistiques, BI, informatique ou équivalent
Expérience : 4 ans d’expérience minimum en tant que data analyst
Compétences obligatoires :
SQL confirmé
Expérience en analyse de données
Bon niveau sur la conception de reporting et KPI
Compétences importantes :
Outil de data visualisation type Power BI, Looker ou équivalent
Modélisation BI confirmée
Qualités personnelles :
Esprit d’analyse
Rigueur
Capacité à travailler avec des données imparfaites
Bon relationnel
Capacité d’adaptation à différents environnements clients
Langues : anglais courant


Déroulement des entretiens


Un premier entretien avec un(e) Digital Sales Manager pour se découvrir mutuellement
Un second entretien avec un(e) associé(e) co-fondateur.rice pour aller plus loin dans les problématiques abordées en mission et les enjeux maîtrisés
Un dernier entretien avec un(e) Consultant(e) Senior, pour faire le point sur votre positionnement et vos compétences


Nous sommes agiles ! Ces entretiens peuvent se faire en visio et/ou en présentiel, dans cet ordre ou un autre.

Qui sont-ils ?

En entreprise, comme en musique, tout est une question de tempo. Depuis 2018, nous réunissons des consultant·e·s passionné·e·s, curieux·ses et ambitieux·ses, uni·e·s par une même conviction : mettre leur expertise au service des défis numériques, sectoriels et industriels de nos clients.

Notre mission ? Accélérer les transformations en combinant excellence opérationnelle, curiosité et audace. Nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs du luxe, du retail, de l’énergie, du transport, du tourisme, de la banque ou encore de l’assurance — partout où la technologie rencontre l’humain.

Nous aimons la tech quand elle connecte et libère les potentiels. Nos consultant·e·s ne se contentent pas de conseiller : ils construisent, testent, mettent en production, mesurent, ajustent et recommencent. Avec nos clients, nous faisons partie du jeu, du début à la fin.

Notre organisation repose sur une culture de la confiance, de l’apprentissage et de la collaboration. Nous avons conçu un cadre unique qui accompagne chaque eXalté·e à chaque étape de sa carrière, avec des rôles clairs, des communautés actives et des rituels qui renforcent le collectif.

Nos eXaltemps trimestriels, notre eXalt Academy et nos projets internes sont autant d’occasions d’apprendre, de partager et de grandir ensemble.

Aujourd’hui présents en France, au Canada, aux États-Unis, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique, en Espagne, au Portugal et à Monaco, nous sommes portés par un engagement fort et une énergie contagieuse.

Parce qu’apprendre est notre discipline, agir notre obsession et réussir ensemble notre plus belle victoire.

Pulse. Make. Learn.

Trois mots qui rythment notre quotidien. Et peut-être bientôt le tien?

Missions à réaliser

Collecter, analyser et interpréter les données pour fournir des insights actionnables et soutenir la prise de décision.

Modalités

Le profil recherché

Compétences requises

Analyse de données, SQL, Excel, Tableau, Power BI, statistiques, Modélisation des données, Visualisations, Documentation

Description Du Profil

  • Solide maîtrise des outils d'analyse de données (SQL, Excel, Tableau, Power BI) - Compétences en statistiques et modélisation des données - Capacité à créer des rapports et des visualisations de données - Excellentes compétences en communication et en documentation - Capacité à analyser les besoins métiers et à fournir des insights actionnables - Esprit analytique et attention aux détails - Capacité à travailler en équipe et à respecter les délais

Langues

Français

À propos de l'entreprise

Les secteurs d'activité

Automobile, Aéronautique, Spatial, Défense & Sécurité, Ferroviaire, Télécommunications, Energie, Services & Systèmes d'Informations, Chimie / Pétrochimie, Digital & E-Commerce, Naval, Machines & Industrie Lourde, Pharmaceutique / Biotechnologie, Banque & Assurance, BTP

Depuis 2016, Kicklox aide talents tech et entreprises industrielles à se rencontrer et collaborer sur des projets innovants.

Title: Data Analist / BI Specialist
HTML:
Als Data Analist / BI Specialist zorg jij ervoor dat organisaties hun data omzetten in waardevolle inzichten. Je analyseert complexe datasets, vertaalt deze naar heldere rapportages en dashboards en adviseert stakeholders over datagedreven beslissingen. Met moderne BI-tools zoals Power BI, Tableau of Qlik maak je informatie toegankelijk en begrijpelijk. Daarmee help je onze klanten – zoals de Belastingdienst, Gemeente Den Haag, Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau en VGZ – om hun beleid en processen te verbeteren en toekomstgericht te sturen.


Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Je hebt een passie voor data en ziet het als jouw missie om cijfers en informatie te vertalen naar verhalen die impact maken. Je bent analytisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en kunt schakelen tussen business en techniek. Je vindt het leuk om samen te werken met collega’s en stakeholders en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar data centraal staat.


Wat kan je van ons verwachten?

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS krijg je de kans om te werken aan uitdagende en innovatieve data- en BI-projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties. Wij investeren in jouw ontwikkeling en bieden naast een inspirerende werkomgeving:

  • Een vast dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 6.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding;
  • Opdrachtkeuzevrijheid: Jij bepaalt in overleg waar je aan werkt, met de begeleiding van een personal coach;
  • Per jaar € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast ook nog eens 5-10 dagen studietijd;
  • Kennissessies met vakgenoten en inhoudelijke events;
  • Minimaal 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen op te bouwen of te verkopen;
  • Sociale events zoals sportdagen, weekend weg en gezellige borrels;
  • Een vestiging bij jou in de buurt.


Persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Bij CIMSOLUTIONS geloven we dat leren de sleutel is tot succes. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar zit in ons DNA. Daarom investeren we continu in jouw groei. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen tot bijvoorbeeld Senior Data Analist, BI Architect of Data Platform Specialist. Je wordt begeleid door ervaren collega’s, krijgt toegang tot kennisplatforms en blijft altijd scherp op de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied.


CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar onder andere leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Daarbij benadrukken wij dat gelijke kansen voor iedereen een belangrijk uitgangspunt zijn in onze selectie.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo bachelor of wo‑opleiding in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Business Analytics of vergelijkbaar;
  • Minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring in een Agile omgeving met het analyseren en interpreteren van data en het vertalen van inzichten naar concrete adviezen;
  • Vaardig in het ontwerpen van dashboards en visualisaties die inzichten helder presenteren met tools zoals PowerBi, Qlik of Tableau;
  • Sterke kennis van en ervaring met SQL en/of Databricks voor analyseren van grote datasets;
  • Kennis van actuele ontwikkelingen op het gebied van data-analyse, data-ethiek en relevante wet- en regelgeving;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;
  • AI-affiniteit is een pré.

Preparación y depuración de datos para análisis y segmentaciones de clientes.
Creación de Dashboards, desarrollos en BD, análisis adhoc.
Comunicación y coordinación constante con las diferentes áreas de Verisure para entender correctamente los datos.


Requisitos Para La Posición


Experiencia mínima de 4-5 años en proyectos de BI en funciones similares.
Titulación universitaria superior: Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística o similar.
Dominio leguaje SQL y experiencia trabajando en BBDD tales como Oracle, SQL Server, Sybase, Snowflake ).
Experiencia demostrable con Power BI o herramienta de visualización de datos similar
Persona proactiva, analítica y con buena capacidad de comunicación.
Clara Orientación al Cliente.


Valorables


Conocimiento de metodologías Agile
Experiencia previa en Python
Experiencia previa con AWS
Experiencia previa con otras herramientas de Visualización y Reporting: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, o de reporting como Business Objects

Description:
Sobre esta Vacante

Serveo

Ubicación: Madrid, Community of Madrid, España

Modalidad: On-site

Industria: Facilities Services

Descripción del Puesto

¿Quieres formar parte del equipo de Serveo?

Si quieres que cada día sea diferente, enfrentándote a nuevos desafíos y formando parte de un equipo que te permita desarrollar todas tus capacidades, ¡sigue leyendo!

En Serveo somos un equipo multidisciplinar, diverso e inclusivo, formado por más de 48.000 profesionales. Somos un referente en servicios deindustria, salud, corporate, government e infraestructuras ofreciendo soluciones integrales, innovadoras y sostenibles.

Sonreímos al cambio y afrontamos juntos cada nuevo reto, impulsando la excelencia de nuestros servicios y fomentando el crecimiento de nuestros equipos en un extraordinario ambiente de trabajo.

¡Estamos orgullosos/as de ser reconocidos como una de las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar en España por Actualidad Económica (El Mundo) y por Forbes y de estar en el Top 5 del Happy Trainees en 2025!

¿En qué consiste el puesto?

Buscamos un Data Analyst en Madrid, cuya misión será transformar los datos en conocimiento accionable para apoyar la toma de decisiones en la organización, analizando, interpretando y visualizando información procedente de múltiples fuentes para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades de mejora.

Funciones a Desarrollar

Analizar y explorar datos, identificando tendencias, patrones y oportunidades que aporten valor al negocio.Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar cuadros de mando e informes, utilizando herramientas de visualización (principalmente Power BI) para facilitar la toma de decisiones.Traducir necesidades de negocio en requerimientos analíticos, colaborando con las distintas áreas para definir métricas e indicadores clave (KPIs).Garantizar la calidad y coherencia de los análisis, validando la integridad de los datos tanto en origen como en el Data Warehouse y asegurando la correcta interpretación de los resultados.Colaborar con otros perfiles de datos, asegurando la disponibilidad, calidad y adecuación de los datos necesarios para el análisis.Documentar métricas, indicadores y definiciones, manteniendo un catálogo claro y consistente que facilite el autoservicio analítico.Impulsar la cultura del dato y el autoservicio, apoyando a los equipos de negocio en el uso autónomo de las herramientas analíticas.Apoyar la toma de decisiones basada en datos, presentando conclusiones y recomendaciones de forma clara a perfiles técnicos y de negocio.Aplicar estándares de gobierno, calidad y seguridad del dato, asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas corporativas en el tratamiento de la información.Analizar y comprender la información de negocio de forma integral, identificando oportunidades de mejora y proponiendo nuevos indicadores, análisis y cuadros de mando que aporten valor a la organización.Participar en la definición e implantación de controles y mecanismos de calidad del dato, monitorizando la información y estableciendo procesos de alerta y comunicación con los Data Owners ante la detección de incidencias o anomalías.Colaborar en el diseño y evolución de datasets analíticos y modelos de datos orientados al reporting y al autoservicio, participando en procesos de integración y transformación de datos.

¿Qué buscamos?

Grado en ingeniería informática, matemáticas, estadística, ADE o similarExperiencia sólida en análisis de datos y dominio de SQL para la consulta, explotación y optimización de datos.Dominio de herramientas de visualización (principalmente Power BI).Conocimiento de arquitecturas de datos en plataformas cloud, especialmente Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Knowledge Catalog, etc.).Conocimiento de Python para análisis, tratamiento y automatización de datos.Inglés (Avanzado)Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en análisis de datos, Business Intelligence o analítica de datos en entornos corporativos con las tecnologías mencionadas.Perfil con capacidad analítica, comunicación, orientación a resultados, mejora continua, atención al detalle, autonomía y proactividad, trabajo en equipo

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido: te ofrecemos un proyecto a largo plazo en una empresa líder en servicios de infraestructuras.

Flexibilidad para facilitar la conciliación. Serveo ha sido galardonada con el Certificado EFR de la Fundación Más Familia, por su implicación en la conciliación personal, familiar y laboral. En este puesto tendrás:Flexibilidad horaria de entrada y salidaJornada continua en verano y festividadesPolítica corporativa de teletrabajo

Paquete retributivo competitivo. Retribución total altamente competitiva en el sector, compuesta por una retribución fija más una retribución variableAcceso a una competitiva 'Bolsa Corporativa de Beneficios' anual que podrás destinar con toda flexibilidad a diferentes productos (tarjeta comida, seguro de salud, tarjeta transporte público, cheque guardería, formación o plan de ahorro) según tus intereses, lo que te permitirá optimizar la fiscalidad de tu retribución y disfrutar de importantes descuentos a los que tenemos acceso como gran empresa.

Desarrollo y proyección profesional: a través de la participación en proyectos transversales, formación y movilidad interna.

Description:

Title: Federal Data Analyst
Description:
Position: Federal Data Analyst

Location: Boston

About Pryzm

Pryzm is transforming how companies engage with the federal government. Today, federal procurement and BD is fragmented across disconnected workflows, siloed intelligence, and institutional knowledge locked in spreadsheets and inboxes. Pryzm brings together market intelligence, budget data, program visibility, and human insights into a single platform that helps teams navigate and win in the federal ecosystem. Pryzm is backed by Tier 1 investors including a16z, and is trusted by organizations across the national security and federal technology ecosystem. Our mission is simple: deliver the best capabilities to the missions that matter most.

The Role

Pryzm's platform depends on data that most companies don't even attempt to track well. We're looking for a Federal Data Analyst to help own that data, keeping it accurate, useful, and ahead of what our customers need. The role blends technical data work with market-facing analysis, and touches everything from day-to-day data quality to the insights we put in front of customers.

What You'll Do


Own and continuously improve pieces Pryzm's federal data, noting meaningful shifts and building structural improvements within the platform
Field customer-requested data pulls end to end, from scoping the ask to delivering a clean, accurate output
Design and build new data feeds and trackers tailored to specific customer use cases and workflows
Mine Pryzm's data for patterns and signal, turning it into thought leadership for existing customers and outbound marketing
Run structured QA passes across personnel, organizational, and program data to catch errors, gaps, and staleness before customers do
Partner with the rest of the data team, shaping long-term priorities for data coverage, structure, and quality
Partner with product and engineering to translate data gaps and customer feedback into architecture and UI improvements


What We're Looking For


0-3 years of experience in a role that combined hands-on data work with analysis or research, or relevant college degree + intern experience.
Technical with Data: you can write basic SQL, work with large or messy datasets, and spot a structural problem before it becomes a customer complaint
Familiarity with government contracting or federal personnel data (USASpending awards, J-Books/budget documents, DoD organizational structure) is a strong plus, but not a requirement.
Strong analytical writing, where you can turn a dataset into a clear, credible narrative for an executive audience
High attention to detail and self-driven mindset.
Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly across data QA, customer requests, and longer-term projects in the same week


Qualifications


Located in Boston. This is a fully on-site position.
US Person required.
Veterans and those with military or intelligence community backgrounds strongly encouraged to apply


Benefits

Pryzm offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:


Competitive salary and meaningful equity
Platinum healthcare: comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage fully covered for employees and dependents
Basic Life/AD&D and long-term disability insurance fully covered, with the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents


Compensation Range: $75K - $90K

The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight

  • Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
  • Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
  • Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
  • Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
  • Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
  • Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
  • Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
  • Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
  • Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
  • Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
  • Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
  • Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
  • Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities

Continuous Improvement & Growth

  • Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
  • Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
  • Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
  • Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
  • Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
  • 3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role (the role may be filled at more than one level; strong candidates earlier in their careers will also be considered)
  • Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
  • Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
  • Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
  • Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
  • Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
  • Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
  • Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
  • Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
  • Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
  • Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
  • Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
  • Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
  • Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
  • Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
  • Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations
