Title: Retail Business Analyst
Description:
Our Brand

At J.Jill, we’re redefining what it means to dress and live with ease. As a women-led, Boston-based lifestyle brand with 200+ stores nationwide, we design thoughtful, inspired apparel and accessories that celebrate the totality of all women. We’re entering an exciting chapter of growth — expanding our footprint, reaching new customers, and deepening long-standing relationships. We're seeking bold thinkers and doers to join us. With competitive pay and benefits, a supportive culture, and the chance to make a real impact, this is more than a job, it’s an opportunity to bring our ethos keep it simple, make it matter to life in new and inspiring ways.

Overview

The Business Analyst partners with cross-functional teams across J.Jill, including Real Estate, Marketing, Retail Operations, and Merchandising, to provide data-driven insights that support strategic business decisions. This role performs end-to-end business analysis by translating business questions into actionable recommendations through SQL queries, Excel spreadsheets, and data visualization. The Business Analyst evaluates business performance, analyzes A/B testing results, develops automated reporting solutions using BI tools such as Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI, and presents findings through clear, impactful presentations and reports. Additionally, the role supports real estate strategy by developing sales forecasts for new store locations, closures, and transfers to help drive profitable growth.

Responsibilities


Builds partnerships and operates cross functionally to provide analytical decision support to leaders to increase revenue and profit of various initiatives.
Takes an active role in conception, design, execution, and analysis of corporate-wide testing activities.
Understands key performance indicators that drive company results and determines how these metrics track against overall business strategies, goals and objectives.
Takes initiative acting as a subject matter expert on analytics, quantification, and process automation and provides advanced analytics to support longer-range plans and initiatives.
Provides recommendations for improvements to tools, scorecards, KPIs & benchmarks.
Performs end-to-end business analytics: 1) Understands business question 2) Structures Excel spreadsheet 3) Builds accurate SQL queries (validating results) 4) Summarizes analytical insights and business recommendations into a PowerPoint deck and/or email.
Performs data analysis tasks, evalution of A/B Tests, etc. to develop recommendations that will improve decision making across the organization.
Develops automated self-service business reporting through BI tools including Qlik Sense and Databricks AI/BI.
Calculates sales estimates for potential new store locations as well as store closure and store transfer estimates for existing stores.


Benefits, Tailored for You.


401(k) retirement plan with discretionary match and tuition reimbursement.
Medical, dental, vision, company paid LTD/STD, and generous amount of paid time off.
Generous associate discount; group discounts on auto, pet and homeowner insurance.
Discount Marketplace for travel, consumer products, food, auto buying, etc.
Associate resource groups.


Qualifications


Advanced SQL skills required; experience with statistical predictive analytics tools like R and Python preferred.
Natural analytical curiosity is essential.
Must demonstrate attention to detail and accuracy, a high degree of organization, and have pride in work.
Desire to continuously learn, ability to learn quickly and confidence to ask questions to gain clarity are required.
Strong aptitude with MS Office tools, especially advanced Excel skills.
Experience with BI tools (e.g., Qlik Sense, Power BI, or Tableau) preferred.
Self-motivated with an ability to both work independently as well as collaboratively across functions and business areas.
Ability to not only retrieve and report data, but to also analyze the implications and make recommendations on various key business questions.
Excellent written and verbal communication/follow-up skills (follow up with project partners to ensure accurate and timely completion of deliverables).
Exposure to retail metrics (sales, inventory, UPT, conversion rates, etc.) preferred.
Ability to manage multiple assignments and consistently meet deadlines.


Education & Experience


3+ years of business experience in an analytical or technical role.
Advanced Excel and SQL skills required.
Statistical analysis and predictive modeling (R, Python) experience preferred.
Reporting and analysis experience in a retail environment preferred.
Bachelor’s degree in business or quantitative discipline (statistics, math) preferred.


The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by associates assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of this position.

At J.Jill, we believe our associates should be seen, valued, and celebrated. We support the advancement of our associates by harnessing their unique contributions to grow and improve, and our success is guided by a culture that values keeping it simple and making it matter. Title: Senior Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst to support grants management operations and reporting across Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH). The Senior Project Manager & Data Analyst will serve as a liaison between grants management stakeholders, technical teams, and system business analysts ensuring the accuracy and integrity of data within the grants management system and related applications. This role will manage data elements, system interactions, and reporting requirements while developing dashboards, management reports, and analytics for leadership and other stakeholders. The position will define and oversee the reporting pipeline for the various grants operations groups, including the selection, validation, and integration of data elements from the grants management system into the enterprise data warehouse to support consistent reporting and analytics. The role will collaborate closely with Grants Administration, Finance, Compliance, Information Systems, and other ancillary groups to support informed decision-making, process improvement, and the effective use of grants management and compliance data. Successful candidates will have demonstrated experience with enterprise data lake queries (like SnowFlake), familiarily with ELT processes, report and dashboard design, and ad hoc reporting using SQL tools and PowerBI.

Leverages software applications to design solutions, performs detailed data mapping and analysis and reviews all data for accuracy and reasonableness prior to distribution. Produces business, research or clinical intelligence.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:


Manages one or more complex data projects. Utilizes hospital systems and database applications to update and analyze data. Prepares and distributes various reports to key stakeholders. Meets with departmental leadership to review reports or requests for data.
Maintains integrity and quality of data and assures data conformity meets operational requirements and goals. Acts as a central resource and integral member of data collection team. Assists in planning, establishing and monitoring criteria for data collection. Trains department staff on data acquisition methods. Extracts data from multiple sources. Audits and resolves all issues.
Ensures application access is in compliance with all regulatory and medical center practices. Acts as gatekeeper for application. Sets and defines user access and determines level of access. Reports all security risks to the application.
Collaborates with IS to obtain and maintain applications used for data collection and reporting. Recommends tools, upgrades and alternatives. Assists in the development of application security and back-up plans. Coordinates interface solution with multiple applications.
Designs and develops reporting and analysis tools. Interprets data and refines analysis. Prepares and presents comprehensive reports. Develops forms, tables and other data tools in the applications that capture, report and consolidate data. Provides application data collection, analytics and reporting expertise. Completes analytics in a timely and efficient manner.
Prepares weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports/dashboards and/or data submissions department.


Required Qualifications


Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Allied Health, or related field.
3-5 years related work experience required.
1-3 years of multiple application maintenance with relational databases.
Advanced technical computer skills as required for technical support specific to functional area and related systems.


Preferred Qualifications


Application Certification for one of the applications used in the department.


Competencies

Written Communications:

Ability to summarize and communicate in English moderately complex information in varied written formats to internal and external customers.

Oral Communications

Ability to comprehend and communicate complex verbal information in English to medical center staff, patients, families and external customers.

Knowledge

Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge of concepts, practices and policies with the ability to use them in complex varied situations.

Teamwork

Ability to act as a team leader for small projects or work groups, creating a collaborative and respectful team environment and improving workflows. Results may impact the operations of one or more departments.

Customer Service

Ability to provide a high level of customer service to patients, visitors, staff and external customers in a professional, service-oriented, respectful manner using skills in active listening and problem solving. Ability to remain calm in stressful situations.

Physical Nature Of The Job

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally in carrying, lifting, pushing, pulling objects. Sitting most of the time, with walking and standing required only occasionally.

Pay Range

$74,880.00 USD - $124,800.00 USD

Title: Senior Health Data Analyst - Payer
Description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Senior Health Data Analyst on the Veeva Compass Product Team, you will play a key role in supporting the core data structures and processes that drive the development of Payer data. You will contribute to data collection, normalization, and analysis to help build Payer reference data. You will be responsible for driving data quality, consistency, and governance for the payer data domain, a foundational reference data set. As a part of our Compass Product Team, you will work alongside Product Managers, Engineering, QA, Terminologists, and Data Analysts to deliver high quality Payer data within our Compass suite of products.

This role is well-suited for someone with a deep understanding of the US insurance landscape, who is also passionate about solving complex data problems. You have a high attention to detail, and a focus on delivering high quality work. In this role, you will be the bridge between the nuances of payer data and actionable product insights.

What You’ll Do


Collect and Maintain Source Data: Identify new data sources and opportunities for automation to ensure all information remains accurate and current
Analyze Data Quality: Execute ongoing quality improvement plan to refine matching process and reduce unmapped data
Establish Governance Standards: Define and maintain standards, documentation, and stewardship models for the payer data domain
Stay Current on the Payer Landscape: Track market trends, including mergers, acquisitions, and rebranding, to assess their impact on our data products
Collaborate on Platform Improvements: Partner with product managers, engineers, and analysts to build scalable, automated processes that ensure trusted data delivery


Requirements


4+ years working with healthcare data, with 2+ years focused on payer data (e.g., payers on claims, payment systems, formulary data)
Deep understanding of the US insurance market, including the nuanced relationships between PBMs and payers across different types of insurance coverage (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, Assistance Programs)
Proficient in SQL for querying, analyzing, and validating large data sets
Proven ability to identify new data sources, establish extraction best practices, and merge them into existing sets
Demonstrated experience in data governance, including theability to create and enforce data standards and naming conventions across a pipeline
Collaborative mindset, with the ability to define data requirements across cross-functional teams


Nice to Have


Experience integrating payer data with other healthcare data types, such as HCO or claims data, is a significant advantage
Experience with Market Access Analytics
Experience in Python
Experience with the BI tool Sigma


Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.


Follow the application process and submit your resume.
Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
Perks & Benefits


Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
Retirement programs
1% charitable giving program


Compensation


Base pay: $80,000 - $125,000

Title: CEMA Business Intel Analyst
Description:
Job Description


Do you love to improve business processes and drive improvement through data analytics? Are you looking for a role that supports a diverse and growing portfolio developing and producing the most advanced electronic systems that protect our warfighters? Are you inspired to join an organization with a strong culture that’s focused on ensuring we hear all voices, being brilliant on the basics, and developing our teams and leaders? BAE systems put our customers first – exemplified by our mission “We Protect Those Who Protect Us®. Come join our team!

We are seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst who will partner with a diverse team of directors, managers, engineers, technicians, and operators to develop solutions for gathering and analyzing data to help overcome challenges and improve business execution. The role requires use of your process knowledge to rapidly translate complex data into actionable insights, improving data accuracy and automation to accelerate ramp to rate, and serve as the factory‑floor liaison to ensure that quantitative findings lead to tangible quality and throughput gains. Candidates must have strong analytical, statistical, and communication skills, a solid foundation in manufacturing processes, and thrive in fast‑paced, dynamic environments.



Key Responsibilities



Partner with cross‑functional teams to turn production data into insights that boost product yield, flow, and cost efficiency.
Be a spokesperson for the factories and get involved in the design, testing, and implementation of dashboards and other data tools with the Analytics Team.
Use data analysis to determine areas for improved process yields, flows, on-time delivery and cost savings measures.
Work directly with the process and product teams to implement improvements.
Champion the implementation of AI solutions and assistants to the factory end users.


If you want an exciting opportunity in a fast-paced environment, where you can partner with a diverse team and contribute to our mission, then this position will provide tremendous professional and personal satisfaction.



Required Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related work experience
Experience with manufacturing standards, processes and techniques
Strong technical skills in data analysis
Strong communication skills
Experience working in cross functional teams
Experience using dashboards and reporting for business intelligence
Experience using GenAI models for analysis




Preferred Education, Experience, & Skills



Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a technical field
Background in data analytics or data science
Experience with Mat lab, Python, SQL, or other programming language
Experience in project management
Process or Product Engineering experience
New product introduction experience
Proven success with change management in a fast-paced, manufacturing environment



Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $118095 - $200762

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Employee Benefits: At BAE Systems, we support our employees in all aspects of their life, including their health and financial well-being. Regular employees scheduled to work 20+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.



About BAE Systems Electronic Systems


BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference. Electronic Systems (ES) is the global innovator behind BAE Systems’ game-changing defense and commercial electronics. Exploiting every electron, we push the limits of what is possible, giving our customers the edge and our employees opportunities to change the world. Our products and capabilities can be found everywhere – from the depths of the ocean to the far reaches of space. At our core are more than 14,000 highly talented Electronic Systems employees with the brightest minds in the industry, we make an impact – for our customers and the communities we serve.

This position will be posted for at least 5 calendar days. The posting will remain active until the position is filled, or a qualified pool of candidates is identified.

Title: Customer Insights Analyst
Description:
Reporting to: SVP, Strategic Analytics

Department: Strategic Analytics

Location: Boston, MA (Hybrid)

Position Summary

Grand Circle Corporation is the leader in international travel, adventure and discovery for Americans aged 50+. Headquartered in Boston MA, and with more than 35 offices globally, more than two million Americans have traveled with our award-winning travel brands: Grand Circle Cruise Line, Overseas Adventure Travel and Grand Circle Travel.

We’re looking for a Customer Insights Analyst to transform how we understand and predict customer behavior. Embedded within the Strategic Analytics department, you will use data to shape brand development and bring value to customers and business teams. This role sits at the intersection of advanced analytics, customer intelligence, and business strategy.

Key Responsibilities


Analyze customer behavior patterns to identify actionable insights and opportunities for targeted marketing interventions
Collaborate with data engineering and BI to ensure data quality and reporting accessibility
Define and monitor KPIs that align with business objectives
Build conceptual dashboards that track customer journeys and identify optimization opportunities
Partner with brand, marketing, and other business teams to translate analytical findings into measurable business impact
Tell data-driven stories that convince and influence leaders using clear insights and recommendations
Develop predictive models for key business metrics including churn, lifetime value, and propensity scoring
Design and run experiments to test hypotheses about customer engagement and measure impact of strategic initiatives


Qualifications


2+ years in data analysis, preferably in a subscription or loyalty focused B2C environment
Advanced SQL proficiency (complex queries, window functions, and optimization)
Strong statistical foundation with hands-on experience in regression, classification, clustering, and time series analysis
Proficiency in Python or R for analysis and modeling
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker, or similar)
Proven ability to communicate the results and recommendations of your analysis to senior leadership
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or quantitative field


Technical Skills


Experience working with cloud data warehouses and large-scale datasets
Proficiency with version control and collaborative development practices
Understanding of data pipeline concepts and ETL processes
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms and services
Knowledge of data governance and security best practices


Nice to Have


Experience with customer data platforms or marketing automation
Knowledge of machine learning frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow)
A/B testing and experimental design expertise
Familiarity with causal inference methodologies and experimentation techniques
Prior experience in travel or hospitality industry


Total Rewards

The base salary range for this role is $110,000 – $130,000 annually for employees based in Boston, MA. Final compensation may vary and will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, this role is eligible for an annual incentive bonus and first-class benefits, which include:


Health & wellness: Comprehensive and heavily subsidized medical, dental, and vision plans, plus on-site gym access, holistic wellness sessions, and group fitness classes
Time for you: Substantial Paid Time Off (PTO), and 11 paid holidays- including Juneteenth, Memorial Day, and Labor Day – and Summer Fridays. Plus- extensive parental leave, with up to 12-16 weeks paid leave at 100% base salary.
Travel more, spend less: 50% off our trips for you and a companion, 25% for additional immediate family members, and exclusive quarterly associate travel deals
Your future, secured: 401(k) with company match, life insurance, and disability coverage
Continuous growth: Tuition assistance for both professional and personal development, opportunities for professional development through oversees travel, and direct access to Pinnacle Leadership & Team Development.
Extra perks: Commuter benefits, FSA options, pet insurance, home & auto discounts, and paid volunteer time off to give back to the community


To learn more, please visit our websites at www.gct.com, www.oattravel.com and www.grandcirclefoundation.org.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for independently delivering on multiple common tasks during a Business Intelligence project on time and of high quality. Depending on the skills and career goals of the analyst, these tasks would include either business consulting and visualization, or technical data design and analysis, or both. The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst is a quantitative analytics professional who specializes in delivering actionable insights and analytics to business users, leveraging an enterprise analytics framework, infrastructure, and operating modelRelevant business areas that could be supported by the analyst span across clinical and operational areas, including but not limited to clinical operations, nursing, quality and patient safety, finance, HR, supply chain, strategy, pharmacy, clinical disciplines, and informatics solutions areas.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.


Responsible for working on multiple (2-3) projects simultaneously supporting multiple business stakeholders
Collaborate with manager to identify high level business need, develop project charter, and consult with the business to define scope
Lead business requirement gathering
Identify data source(s) and develop technical data design requirements
Develop viz wireframes and leverage BI tools to craft visualizations and dashboards
Write SQL queries to develop data sources
Collaborate with internal teams and stakeholders for QA and UAT
Conduct stakeholder training
Share knowledge within COBA and train analysts on common tasks
Contribute to development of analytic assets that can be used institute wide
Address stakeholder feedback, concerns and aim to deliver a high-level of customer service


Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required


Proficient with SQL
Proficient with BI tools e.g., Tableau
Proficient navigating Epic Hyperspace to Clarity Data Model to data warehouse
Able to set appropriate expectations, discuss and present results to customer in formal settings, share ideas accurately and communicate them effectively, both in writing and verbally with supervisory oversight
Ability to contribute to the development and growth of others
Strong interpersonal skills with ability to effectively interact with all levels of staff
Excellent analytical, organizational, and time management skills
Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
Curious and motivated learner


Minimum Job Qualifications

The position requires a bachelor’s degree in a STEM field and at least 3 years of relevant experience, including 1 year in healthcare. Experience with Tableau and Clarity Data models is preferred.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None

PATIENT CONTACT: None

At Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, we work every day to create an innovative, caring, and inclusive environment where every patient, family, and staff member feels they belong. Title: Senior Data Solutions Analyst: Operational Data & Reporting team
Description:
Description

Ensuring that data is a competitive differentiator for our enterprise, the USRM Data Office sets strategic data product visions, governs data for quality and compliance, develops best in class data and reporting solutions, and continuously seeks to optimize the value that data creates for our customers and company. Our team includes data analysts, data stewards, data strategists, and data product owners — performance-driven individuals who make sure that data is appropriately leveraged across every layer of our business.

The Operational Data & Reporting team within USRM Data Office is seeking a Senior Data Solutions Analyst focusing on scalable data & reporting solutions and insights for a range of stakeholders within our Direct Distribution and Partnerships reporting team.

This position may have in-office requirements dependent upon candidate location

Candidates who live within 50 miles of Boston, MA; Portsmouth, NH; Seattle, WA; Columbus, OH; or Plano, TX will follow a hybrid schedule, coming into the office two days per week. Otherwise, this role is remote.

Responsibilities


Design and develop scalable data solutions with a focus on reusability that enable effective self-service data consumption and can describe their value to the customer.
Independently works on prototyping/developing data solutions that meet the needs of the organization and business customers. Coding scalable proof-of-concepts and solutions.
Stay up to date with advancements in data engineering, evaluate new tools and recommend adoption where appropriate.
Identify opportunities to apply Gen AI for data discovery, lineage summarization, automated documentation, query generation and developer productivity (prompt engineering and code generation)
Designs proof-of-concept solutions utilizing and advanced understanding of multiple coding languages to meet technical and business requirements with an ability to perform iterative solution testing to ensure specifications are met.
Strive to become a technical leader and mentor for the team, providing assistance & guidance to junior team members
Optimize and tune data infrastructure for performance, scalability, reliability and cost-efficiency
Prioritizes efforts based on customer value and can set expectations for deliverables of high complexity.
Ensure data solutions include activities and deliverables required to achieve high data quality and displays a strong understanding of complex, multi-tier, multi-platform systems, applying principles of metadata, lineage, business definitions, compliance and data security to project work.


The Ideal Candidate Will


Have strong technical aptitude with data manipulation, data wrangling and Reporting tools (SQL, Power Bi, SAS, Python cloud computing: AWS and Snowflake).
Demonstrate 3+ years of experience building production data pipelines, data solutions and Power Bi Dashboards.
Possess hands-on experience with data quality testing frameworks and practices,and experience implementing automated data tests and validation.
Have excellent communication skills and the ability to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
3-5+ years’ experience in coding for data management, data warehousing, or other data environments, including, but not limited to, ETL & scripting languages (Python)
3-5+ years’ experience with top quadrant Business Intelligence tools. Demonstrated technical knowledge and skills in coding languages and business intelligence tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI SAS, Python) and interest in expanding knowledge in this space.
Must possess strong analytical, strategic, project management, decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Direct Distribution domain knowledge preferred but not required.
Demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of new technologies as needed to progress initiative and ability to adapt
Able to describe value and support the prioritization of data solutions.
Able to organize and address customer pain points.


Qualifications


Strong written and oral communication skills required
Bachelor`s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline preferred
Master`s in same or related disciplines strongly preferred
3-5 years experience in coding for data management, data warehousing, or other data environments, including, but not limited to, working in NoSQL implementation, ETL, Java, scripting languages (Python, Perl, Shell), and the Hadoop stack

Title: Associate Data Analyst
Description:
At MarketOnce, we empower businesses with the insights and strategies they need to excel in today's dynamic market. With a strong foundation in market research, we offer innovative solutions in research, software, consulting, advertising, and marketing to corporate, private equity firms, and other organizations seeking to achieve their goals.

Our team is distinguished by their client-centric approach—treating each client's business with the dedication and care as if it were their own. This commitment enables us to deliver personalized service and achieve the highest standards of success and innovation in everything we do. Together, our family of companies, including MarketOnce, ROI Rocket, and eAccountable, work towards delivering unparalleled solutions. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, our global team collaborates from locations across the US and Europe.

We value curiosity, creativity, collaboration, and expertise, continuously striving to push boundaries and exceed our clients' expectations. Join us to be part of a culture that drives meaningful results.

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a data analyst with a minimum of three years’ experience to clean, structure and process data from primary market research. An understanding of quantitative marketing research techniques, tools, processes, and procedures is preferred. Experience in primary market research is required. You must have strong interpersonal and organizational skills and be detail-oriented, flexible and above all, collaborative. The range of duties includes enforcing data quality control protocols, cleaning and structuring data sets, generating data cross tabulations and conducting a variety of analytical procedures.

In this role, you will be working closely with the Sr. Director of Custom Research, various Research Managers, the Director of Marketing Sciences, fellow Data Analysts and various Publishing department personnel.

What You'll Do


Clean and structure complex data sets in SPSS/alternate platforms, including AI-based apps

Title: Clinical Data Analyst
Description:
The Clinical Data Analyst (CDA) is a mid-level individual contributor role that supports the Data Sciences department in identifying requirements and building solutions towards enhancing clinical study data reporting and analytics capabilities.  This role will support in the development of advanced analytical solutions, better supporting internal and external stakeholders needs in summarizing clinical study data. This role will also enable operational quality and efficiency through the generation and analysis of departmental operational and performance metrics.




 




Reporting Standards Management


Lead the creation & development of a standard library of reporting and/or analysis solutions (report, dashboard, visualization, or other) for Data Sciences and other stakeholders


Gather requirements from a cross-functional group to a particular study question or operational activity


Build & configure solution to meet the requirements


Lead validation activities to prepare reporting solutions for release/usage


Gather (as needed) and collaborate with volunteer stakeholder group to support validation activities


Contribute to the Data Standards Governance Committee (DSGC) for the management of standard reports


Maintain ongoing updates to standard report templates


Support training for the Data Sciences team of new standard reports/solutions







Study-Specific Reporting Deployment


Deploy standard reporting solutions for use on a study-specific basis


Create & develop ad hoc reporting and/or analysis solutions – report, dashboard, visualization, or other – as requested by study team members


Gather requirements from study team member(s) for ad hoc solutions


Build & configure ad hoc solutions to meet the requirements


Support report requestor in validation activities of study-specific ad hoc solutions to prepare for release/usage


Support long-term maintenance of study-specific solutions and contribute to investigating issues, as raised by study team members







Department Operational & Performance Analysis


Identify requirements with Data Sciences leaders to measure & monitor operational and performance metrics


Design, build, and maintain metrics governance within Data Sciences


Work with large data sets to analyze operational & study data and deliver reporting that outline areas for process & performance improvement/optimization (inefficiencies, inaccuracies, and other issues) to Data Sciences leadership







Technical Systems


Participate in the strategy, management and integration of data reporting systems that impact Data Sciences, including the assessment, integration, build of vendor systems and Alimentiv technologies


Act as a technical system subject matter expert; perform validation and testing of systems


Help gather and determine requirements for relevant technical systems, with cross-functional groups or other Business/Process analysts. Work closely with other technical roles (Data Management, Database Programming, Statistics, Enterprise Analyses, etc.) to drive data governance and excellence


Assess ways to further leverage existing systems to optimize internal efficiencies and processes


Support Data Sciences contribution to a Data Warehouse, contributing to key decisions and strategy


While evaluating new projects or requests for enhancements, help determine the project cost, timeline, goals and feasibility and then support the project through completion







Qualifications


Minimum of a Bachelor's degree + 4-6 years of related experience


Strong analytical skills


Visual design and aesthetic sense to produce appealing and intuitive outputs


Proficiency with data visualization tools (i.e., PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc)


Skilled data storyteller to communicate complex information in clear and effective manner


Strong collaborator


Preference to certificate in data analysis, data visualizations, or technical solutions (i.e., PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc.)


Preference to prior Clinical Research and/or Clinical Data Management experience







Working Condition


Home-based

Title: Technical Data Analyst 5423
Description:
We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive Technical Data Analyst to support enterprise data quality, migration, and integration initiatives. The ideal candidate will have experience with data migration planning and execution, including assessing, profiling, cleansing, validating, and transforming large datasets, while also developing reporting and integration solutions to support multiple business and technical teams.




Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years of experience in data analysis, data quality, or data management within enterprise environments.
Strong understanding of data governance, data quality principles, and data lifecycle management.
Demonstrated strength in verbal and written communication tailored for technical, cross-functional, and executive audiences.




Technical Skills

Experience performing data profiling to assess completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, and validity of enterprise data.
Proven ability to execute data cleansing, standardization, deduplication, and validation activities using established data quality methodologies.
Experience developing and maintaining data mapping documents, data conversion templates, validation templates, reconciliation reports, and data quality scorecards.
Proficiency in writing SQL and scripting (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or similar) to automate data cleansing, transformation, validation, and reconciliation processes.
Experience in creating automated validation routines to compare source and target datasets and identify data quality issues.
Strong knowledge of relational databases and data modeling concepts.
Reporting & Analytics
Experience developing interactive dashboards and reports using Tableau and/or Microsoft Power BI.
Ability to analyze data quality metrics and communicate findings through executive dashboards and technical reports.
Experience creating KPIs and visualizations to monitor data quality, migration progress, and operational performance.

Integration & APIs

Experience working with MuleSoft for API-led integrations and enterprise data exchange.
Understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON, XML, and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience supporting API testing, validation, and troubleshooting.
Familiarity with integrating cloud applications, including CRM platforms such as Salesforce, using APIs.

Preferred Qualifications

Proactive, self-directed, and comfortable identifying gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities in data migration, reporting, and integration workstreams.
Experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining data migration plans for enterprise data migration initiatives
Experience supporting Salesforce CRM implementations, migrations, or data quality initiatives.
Experience with ETL/data integration tools and enterprise data migration projects.
Familiarity with data quality platforms such as Cloudingo, DemandTools, Informatica, Talend, or similar solutions.
Experience working in Agile delivery environments and using tools to support implementations such as Jira.
Knowledge of healthcare, provider, payer, or regulated industry data.




Key Responsibilities

Support data migration planning activities, including reviewing migration artifacts, documenting validation needs, tracking reconciliation activities, and identifying execution-readiness considerations.
Analyze source data from multiple software systems and understand underlying data models
Perform data profiling and quality assessments to identify gaps, inconsistencies, duplicates, and validation issues.
Design and execute data cleansing and transformation activities to improve data quality.
Develop scripts and automated processes for data validation, cleansing, reconciliation, and exception reporting.
Create and maintain data mapping documents, conversion templates, and validation artifacts.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, developers, and data stewards to resolve data quality issues.
Translate complex data quality findings into clear technical documentation, business recommendations, and executive-level summaries.
Build Tableau and Power BI dashboards to monitor data quality, migration readiness, and business metrics.
Support API integrations and data exchange using MuleSoft and REST APIs.
Validate that integrations and data exchanges satisfy documented business requirements, data quality expectations, and operational needs.
Document findings, recommendations, and technical specifications to support ongoing data governance and continuous improvement.

Title: Principal People Data Analyst
Description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

Reporting to: SVP of People Operations

Location: Boston, MA office (hybrid)

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal People Data Analytics Analyst to lead advanced people analytics and workforce insights, with Workday serving as the backbone of our people data ecosystem.

This role will be responsible for turning Workday data into strategic insights that inform workforce planning, talent management, organizational effectiveness, employee retention, compensation, and broader People strategy. In this role, you will partner closely with the People Leadership Team, HR Technology, Finance, business leaders, and other stakeholders to ensure that Workday data is trusted, well-governed, accessible, and translated into meaningful business intelligence.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in People Analytics and Workday data with strong analytical, technical, and consulting capabilities. This individual will operate as a subject-matter expert, establish analytical standards and best practices, and serve as a strategic advisor to senior leaders.

Key Responsibilities


Serve as a subject-matter expert for Workday people data, including the underlying data structures, business processes, organizational hierarchies, worker data, job and position data, compensation, recruiting, talent, and other adjacent technologies.
Use Workday as the primary source and foundation for enterprise people analytics, ensuring that workforce insights are grounded in consistent and trusted data.
Develop and maintain sophisticated analytical datasets, metrics, dashboards, and reporting solutions leveraging Workday data.
Partner with HR Technology and HRIS teams to understand and optimize Workday configuration, data structures, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to improve Workday data quality, consistency, completeness, and usability for analytics.
Establish standardized definitions and methodologies for critical workforce metrics, using Workday as the system of record wherever appropriate.
Evaluate data flows between Workday and downstream data warehouses, business intelligence platforms, and other enterprise systems.


People Analytics & Strategic Insights


Lead high-impact analytics initiatives addressing complex workforce and business questions.
Analyze workforce data to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities across the employee lifecycle.
Develop predictive and advanced analytics to support workforce planning, retention, talent management, organizational effectiveness, and employee experience.
Connect people metrics to business outcomes to help leaders understand the organizational implications of workforce trends.
Develop executive-level dashboards and data solutions that provide clear, actionable visibility into the workforce.
Translate complex analytical findings into compelling recommendations for senior People leaders and executives.


Strategic Partnership


Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to senior People leaders, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business executives.
Partner with HR Technology, HRIS, Compensation, Talent, Recruiting, Finance, and other teams to develop integrated workforce insights.
Proactively identify important workforce trends and analytical opportunities rather than relying solely on reporting requests.
Influence strategic decisions through data-driven recommendations and clear executive storytelling.
Lead analytical projects from problem definition through analysis, recommendation, and implementation.


Data Governance & Analytics Architecture


Help establish and maintain a trusted People data foundation centered on Workday.
Define and document enterprise people metrics, data definitions, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards.
Partner with HR Technology and Data teams to establish appropriate data governance, lineage, quality controls, and access practices.
Identify gaps between Workday data and other enterprise data sources and develop approaches for reconciling and integrating information.
Promote responsible use of employee data, including appropriate privacy, confidentiality, security, and access controls.
Help shape the evolution of the People Analytics data architecture and technology roadmap.


Technical & Analytical Leadership


Leverage Workday reporting and analytics capabilities, including Workday Report Writer, calculated fields, composite reports, dashboards, and other relevant Workday reporting technologies.
Develop visualizations and analytical products using tools such as Visier, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Evaluate opportunities to use predictive analytics, machine learning, experimentation, and other advanced methodologies to improve workforce decision-making.
Mentor analysts and provide analytical and technical guidance across the People Analytics organization.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Human Resources, Computer Science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
8+ years of experience in People Analytics, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
Deep experience working with Workday as a primary source of people data, including strong understanding of its data model, reporting capabilities, business processes, and organizational structures.
Strong understanding of workforce metrics, HR processes, and the employee lifecycle.
Experience translating Workday data into executive dashboards, analytical models, and strategic insights.
Experience with Workday reporting technologies such as Report Writer, calculated fields, dashboards, and/or advanced reporting capabilities.
Experience working with downstream data warehouses, BI platforms, or enterprise data environments connected to Workday.
Strong statistical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate complex findings to executive and non-technical audiences.
Strong business acumen and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders.
High degree of discretion and understanding of employee data privacy, confidentiality, and governance.


Preferred Qualifications


Workday certification or significant hands-on Workday reporting experience.
Experience with Workday Prism Analytics or other Workday analytics capabilities.
Experience with Workday integrations and downstream data pipelines.
Experience integrating Workday data with Finance, Finance Planning, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, or other enterprise systems.
Experience with predictive workforce analytics, attrition modeling, workforce planning, or organizational network analysis.
Experience establishing enterprise People Analytics data governance and metric frameworks.
Experience in a complex, global, or rapidly scaling organization.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means creating a trusted, Workday-centered people data foundation that enables leaders to make faster, more informed workforce decisions.

The Principal People Analytics Analyst will ensure that Workday data is not simply reported—it is understood, connected, analyzed, and translated into strategic insight. Leaders should be able to trust the underlying data, understand what the metrics mean, and confidently use the resulting insights to make decisions about people, talent, organization, and business performance.

Core Competencies


Workday & People Data Expertise
Advanced People Analytics
Strategic Thinking
Data Architecture & Governance
Statistical & Quantitative Analysis
Executive Data Storytelling
Business Acumen
Stakeholder Influence
Data Visualization
Problem Solving
Innovation
Collaboration & Mentorship
Judgment & Discretion

  • Experience with Workday integrations and downstream data pipelines.
  • Experience integrating Workday data with Finance, Finance Planning, Recruiting, Talent, Compensation, or other enterprise systems.
  • Experience with predictive workforce analytics, attrition modeling, workforce planning, or organizational network analysis.
  • Experience establishing enterprise People Analytics data governance and metric frameworks.
  • Experience in a complex, global, or rapidly scaling organization.

Success in this role means creating a trusted, Workday-centered people data foundation that enables leaders to make faster, more informed workforce decisions.

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Federal Acquisition Service
Description:
Summary

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will turn raw data into actionable insights to drive strategy by focusing on trends, creating dashboards, and optimizing business processes to improve customer relationship management.

Location of position: GSA, Federal Acquisition Service, Office of Business Optimization

We are currently filling one vacancy, but additional vacancies may be filled as needed.

Learn more about this agency

Duties

The duty location will be determined at the time of selection in one of the following locations: Washington, DC; Kansas City, MO; Fort Worth, TX; Lakewood, CO; Tacoma, WA; Atlanta, GA; New York, NY; Boston, MA; San Francisco, CA; Philadelphia, PA; Chicago, IL; Norfolk, VA; Tampa, FL; Houston, TX; San Antonio, TX; and/or Orlando, FL.

The Office of Business Optimization, or Optimize, serves as the “dot connector” converting the Federal Acquisition Service vision into an operational reality to drive acquisition excellence. Our office is dedicated to enterprise-wide excellence in operations, proactive customer engagement, and cultivating a top-tier workforce.

Optimize is responsible for strategy development, procedure optimization, supply chain risk management, and data analytics to inform smart business decisions.

Turning raw data into actionable insights to drive strategy, focusing on trends, creating dashboards, and optimizing business processes to improve customer relationship management.

Working with Federal Acquisition Service (FAS) business units and portfolios to define and document requirements; gathering, developing, and writing user stories that support business requirements; supporting and assisting with prioritization of tasks within the Change Control Board (CCB) and help maintain the requirements backlog for sprint releases.
Preparing and conducting briefings for higher level management to explain the impact of business decisions, providing recommendations, viable solutions, or action plans, and proposing guidance and direction for implementation of recommendations.
Creating, updating, and maintaining project documents including: business requirements, functional and non-functional requirements, functional design, data mapping, and report specifications.



Requirements

Conditions of employment


US Citizenship or National (Residents of American Samoa and Swains Island)
Meet all eligibility criteria within 30 days of the closing date
Meet time-in-grade within 30 days of the closing date, if applicable
Register with Selective Service if you are a male born after 12/31/1959
Direct Deposit of salary check to financial organization required.



If selected, you must meet the following conditions:


Current or Former Political Appointees: The Office of Personnel Management (OPM) must authorize employment offers made to current or former political appointees. If you are currently, or have been within the last 5 years, a political Schedule A, Schedule C or Non­Career SES employee in the Executive Branch, you must disclose this information to the HR Office. Failure to disclose this information could result in disciplinary action including removal from Federal Service.
Serve a one year probationary period, if required.
Undergo and pass a background investigation (Tier 2 investigation level).
Have your identity and work status eligibility verified if you are not a GSA employee. We will use the Department of Homeland Security’s e-Verify system for this. Any discrepancies must be resolved as a condition of continued employment.



Qualifications

To evaluate your qualifications, your resume must clearly demonstrate how you meet the specialized experience described below. Your resume must not exceed two pages. To ensure your qualifications can be fully evaluated, we recommend including the following information:


Name, address, telephone number, email address;
Job Title (if Federal Service, provide series and grade; if not in GS plan, provide GS equivalent grade);
Relevant work experience—should include employer name, job title, start and end dates (month/year), the number of hours worked per week and descriptions that explain how you meet the required qualifications in the job announcement.
Education, certifications or licensures—If the job announcement requires any education, certifications or licensures, make sure to include the required information and any required documents like transcripts.



Your resume should contain enough information to make a valid determination that you fully meet experience requirements for each grade level you are applying to. If you do not provide enough information for us to determine your qualifications, you may be rated ineligible.

If you have volunteered your service through a National Service program (e.g., Peace Corps, Americorps), we encourage you to apply and include this experience on your resume.

The GS-13 salary range starts at $106,437.00per year. If you are a new federal employee, your starting salary will likely be set at the Step 1 of the grade for which you are selected.

To qualify, you must have at least one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 level or higher in the Federal service.

Specialized experience is experience optimizing business processes to improve customer relationship management and contract management. Such experience must include utilizing electronic-business, customer relationship management (CRM), and business intelligence (BI) systems:


Performing audits concerning contract and customer data management for organizational compliance;
Conducting analytical studies to benchmark metrics to identify performance gaps, establish realistic goals, and implement targeted improvements to drive business success;
Reviewing contract and customer data to ensure compliance with contractual terms; and
Compiling data to translate technical reports into presentations for customers and/or senior management.



Additional information

Candidates will not be hired based on their race, sex, color, religion, or national origin.

Applicants are encouraged to make their resume searchable in their USAJOBS.gov profile. This will allow Federal hiring specialists and hiring managers across agencies to find their resume as part of agency recruitment campaigns or staffing searches.

If you apply to this position and are selected, we will not ask about your criminal history before you receive a conditional job offer. If you believe you were asked about your criminal history improperly, contact the agency or visit GSA's webpage.

Relocation-related expenses are not approved and will be your responsibility.

On a case-by-case basis, the following incentives may be approved:


Recruitment incentive if you are new to the federal government
Relocation incentive if you are a current federal employee
Credit toward vacation leave if you are new to the federal government



Additional vacancies may be filled through this announcement in this or other GSA organizations within the same commuting area as needed; through other means; or not at all.

Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.

Benefits





A career with the U.S. government provides employees with a comprehensive benefits package. As a federal employee, you and your family will have access to a range of benefits that are designed to make your federal career very rewarding. Opens in a new windowLearn more about federal benefits.

You will have access to many benefits including:


Health insurance (choose from a wide range of plans)
Life insurance coverage with several options
Sick leave and vacation time, including 11 paid holidays per year
Thrift Savings Plan (similar to a 401(k) plan)
Transit and child care subsidies
Flexible spending accounts
Long-term care insurance
Training and development



Eligibility for benefits depends on the type of position you hold and whether your position is full-time, part-time or intermittent. Contact the hiring agency for more information on the specific benefits offered.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About the Company

South Coast Community Services is a behavioral health nonprofit with over 40 years of history serving individuals, families, and youth across Southern California. SCCS delivers mental health services through county contracts with San Bernardino County and Orange County, managed care agreements, commercial insurance, and school district partnerships (NPA-certified). Our team of 400 includes more than 160 clinicians operating across San Bernardino and Orange Counties and beyond. SCCS accepts Medi-Cal, managed care, and commercial insurance plans.




About the Role

The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for supporting organizational decision-making through the development of reliable reporting, data analysis, and documentation of systems and data structures. This role works across clinical, operational, and financial datasets to produce accurate, actionable insights and maintain a clear understanding of how data flows across systems.




The position requires strong technical skills in SQL and Tableau, along with the ability to work with complex relational data environments, including behavioral health EHR systems. A key focus of this role is ensuring data clarity and consistency by documenting existing data sources, reporting logic, and system relationships, enabling more effective and scalable analytics across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Care, Finance, Clinical Operations, and IT to deliver reporting and analysis that supports day-to-day operations and ongoing performance improvement.




Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Reporting

Develop, maintain, and enhance Tableau dashboards and reports supporting referral tracking, intake performance, clinician activity, and program metrics.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, join, and transform data from complex relational databases.
Produce recurring and ad hoc reports to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Ensure accuracy and consistency of reported data through validation and reconciliation processes.




Data Systems Documentation and Structure

Document current data systems, including data sources, table structures, field definitions, and relationships across systems.
Maintain clear documentation of reporting logic, metric definitions, and calculation methodologies.
Identify gaps or inconsistencies in data structures and escalate opportunities for improvement.
Support the development and maintenance of data dictionaries and internal documentation resources.




Data Quality and Integrity

Perform regular audits to identify data inconsistencies, missing values, or reporting discrepancies.
Partner with IT and operational teams to investigate and resolve data quality issues.
Ensure alignment between source system data (e.g., EHR, CRM, billing systems) and reporting outputs.




Cross-Functional Support

Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate business questions into data queries and visualizations.
Support multiple departments including Marketing, Finance, Customer Care, and Clinical Operations with data requests and analysis.
Present findings in a clear, concise manner appropriate for both technical and non-technical audiences.




EHR and Data Environment Support
Work with behavioral health EHR data to support reporting and analysis needs.
Assist in extracting and validating data from EHR and connected systems.
Develop familiarity with system workflows and data capture processes to improve reporting accuracy.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields such as data analytics, statistics, mathematics, health informatics, or related discipline.
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, and data transformation.
Experience building dashboards and visualizations in Tableau or a similar BI tool.
Experience working with complex relational databases and multi-source data environments.
Demonstrated ability to document data systems, reporting logic, and workflows clearly and accurately.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.




Preferred Skills




Experience working in healthcare or behavioral health environments.
Familiarity with EHR systems and healthcare data structures.
Understanding of basic financial or operational metrics in a service-based organization.
Experience supporting cross-functional teams with reporting and analytics.




Pay range and compensation package

$100,000 - $125,000




Equal Opportunity Statement

EOE, INCLUDING DISABILITY/VETS We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under California law.




Management reserves the right to add, change, delete or rescind duties or responsibilities of positions within the job classification at any time.

Title: Analyst, Data & Analytics
Description:
Permanent Full Time

Canada Life is seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join the Insurance Solutions team. As a part of the Performance Management area, this role will be responsible for supporting the data management, analysis, and reporting needs of the department. The Data Analyst supports decision-making, monitors business performance, and provides actionable insights using analytics and visualizations tailored to different audiences.

The role will benefit from collaboration with subject matter experts and data scientists. If you are looking to become a subject matter expert in connected data and help guide the team in improving processes through data mining and analysis, this is the role for you.

Given the size and scope of our organization, we have the flexibility for this position to be located in the following head office locations: Toronto and London.

What You Will Do


Build, implement, and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards, keeping in mind the needs of varied audiences
Create visually compelling presentations and use strong communication skills to present them to stakeholders (ability to build a narrative that outlines the background and highlights the impact of initiatives)
Identify opportunities to ingest data, prioritize data needs, and build data marts to drive efficiencies in reporting functions
Leverage data expertise to support new initiatives through analysis and ongoing reporting across the entire analytics lifecycle
Communicate requirements to the Technology team for development and ensure smooth deployment of data projects after performing data quality testing
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver data solutions that meet business needs
Support existing data owners in their data management practices, ensuring a single source of truth
Work with large datasets that may be inconsistent, unclean, or not fully modeled
Ensure best practices are followed with respect to data governance and structure
Communicate effectively while demonstrating critical thinking and business acumen


What You Will Bring


University or College education in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, data modelling, and Databricks, with experience creating interactive dashboards
Ability to work with diverse data inputs and build data marts aligned with business requirements
Proven ability to learn quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work with little to no documentation or instructions
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to produce high-quality outputs under tight timelines
Driven to continuously improve processes, performance, and efficiency

Description:
Verisign helps enable the security, stability, and resiliency of the internet. We are a trusted provider of internet infrastructure services for the networked world and deliver unmatched performance in domain name system (DNS) services.

We are a mission focused, values driven company where each individual can contribute to building a stronger, more secure internet. We offer a dynamic and flexible work environment with competitive benefits and the ability to grow your career.




The Data Analyst II, as a member of the Business Intelligence and Data Analytics team, analyzes and helps solve complex business problems using data and available resources to provide insight to decision-makers. In this role, you will analyze trends in domain name usage, digital service activation and channel distribution dynamics.




The role requires consistent communication across teams -- including marketing, account management, product management, finance, and platform engineering -- to translate between technical and behavior trends and end-user demand characteristics. Your work on the team will involve studying data trends and patterns to derive insights that support data-driven presentations with creative visualizations highlighting key trends.




An ideal candidate cares deeply about data quality, visualization, business impact, and understanding global DNS or the broader web hosting ecosystem.




Summary of key responsibilities:

Evaluate extensive datasets leveraging large-scale data analysis platforms to explain how end users are utilizing domain names
Create specifications for data acquisition to support exploration of emerging technologies impacting the global DNS.
Develop and maintain manual and automated processes to ensure data quality and integrity.
Research trends to support briefings, presentations, and reporting on business performance and progress relative to plans.
Support the formation of recommendations and strategic/tactical plans based on capturing relevant business metrics.




Qualifications:

4 years of progressively responsible, related business and/or data analysis experience
Bachelor’s degree in either Computer Science, Data Analytics or Business, or equivalent work experience, is required
Strong Excel and SQL skills required, with hands-on experience with data visualization tooling (such as Tableau or related tools)
Strong analytic skills and the ability to share insights with peers
Demonstrable planning and organization skills
Experience performing data ETL, including designing data collection methods, data models, and transformation processes for relational databases (Oracle/SQL) and distributed data systems (such as Snowflake, Hadoop, Spark with scripting languages like Python)




This position is based in our Reston, VA office and offers a hybrid work schedule.




The pay range is $89,900 - $121,700.




The anticipated annual base salary range for this position is noted above, however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience. Verisign offers a discretionary bonus which is based on individual and company performance, and certain roles may be eligible for discretionary stock awards.

Title: Sr. Data Analyst
Description:
Overview

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing Results that Matter. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear-sighted commitment to the mission. SPA: Objective. Responsive. Trusted.

The Joint, Office of the Secretary of Defense, Interagency Division provides expert support services to a range of customers spanning across the Department of Defense, Federal Civilian, and international markets. JOID provides a diverse portfolio of analytical and programmatic capabilities to help our customers make informed decisions on their most challenging issues.

The Industry and Security Analysis Group (ISAG) within JOID provides analytical, technical, and program support to promote, grow, and protect the U.S. industrial base. ISAG’s support spans the Department of Defense (DOD), Department of Commerce, and other agencies to deliver critical decision support to national security leaders. Our team informs policy decisions, enables execution of comprehensive strategies and monitors and reports on the effectiveness of implementation. This enables senior leaders to execute strategies for developing and sustaining a robust industrial base that meets our nation’s strategic resource objectives. From policy to practice, we are a team of economic and national security professionals providing innovative solutions for our Nation’s most pressing security challenges.

We have an immediate need for a Sr. Data Analyst to provide onsite support out of the Pentagon and/or Mark Center in Alexandria, VA.

Responsibilities

The Sr. Data Analyst will support the newly formed Assistant Secretary of War for International Armaments Cooperation. Provide a dedicated data analytics capability in converting large volumes of data from disparate sources into decision-quality products. Manage data extraction, cleansing, and normalization from Department of War data platforms and other validated sources to support analysis and visualization for senior government leaders. Sources include Project Management Resource Tools (PMRT), Foreign Military Sales Single Tracking System (STS), International Agreements Tracking System (IATS), and Advana. Assist with streamlining ASW IAC workflows via PowerBI and PowerAutomate tools.

Qualifications

Required:


Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field
3+ years of experience developing automated data pipelines, processing complex government datasets, and building business intelligence dashboards
Expert proficiency with PowerBI, PowerAutomate, and Sharepoint systems
Active Secret clearance
Able to work fully onsite based on client needs


Desired


Active TS/SCI clearance
5+ years of experience


Pay Range Information

At SPA, we strive to deliver a robust total compensation package that will attract and retain top talent. Elements of the compensation package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. SPA provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. Canada Life is seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join the Insurance Solutions team. Build, implement, and maintain data models, custom reports, and dashboards, keeping in mind the needs of varied audiences

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver data solutions that meet business needs

Ensure best practices are followed with respect to data governance and structure
Communicate effectively while demonstrating critical thinking and business acumen

University or College education in a related field of study, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Experience working with raw data and manipulating large datasets
Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, data modelling, and Databricks, with experience creating interactive dashboards
Ability to work with diverse data inputs and build data marts aligned with business requirements
Proven ability to learn quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work with little to no documentation or instructions
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to produce high-quality outputs under tight timelines
Driven to continuously improve processes, performance, and efficiency
Knowledge of the organization, distribution channels, products, systems, and data is an asset
Ability to write complex SQL queries to extract and integrate data from multiple sources
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python or R
Hands-on experience with Azure compute services and a good understanding of Azure Data Factory pipelines
Preferred: Microsoft Certified – Azure Data Analyst Associate (Power BI) certification


The base salary for this position is between $65,800 - $87,700 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc).
